words.en: A fellow is a man or boy. In British English, a fellow is also a member of certain academic societies.

words.tr: v. 快速移动；（因吃惊、害怕或激动而）猛地一动；跳( jump的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The cat jumped over the fence.
words.ex_cn: 猫快速移动跳过了篱笆。
words.en: To push yourself off the ground and into the air using your legs and feet.

words.ex: He solved the crossword puzzle quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快解开了这个填字谜。
words.en: If something puzzles you, you do not understand it and feel confused.

words.ex: Nobody knows the answer.
words.ex_cn: 没有人知道答案。
words.en: Nobody means not any person or no person.

words.ex: He drinks two litres of water every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天喝两升水。
words.en: A litre is a metric unit of capacity, formerly defined as the volume of one kilogram of water under standard conditions, now equal to 1,000 cubic centimetres (about 1.75 pints).

words.ex: The baby's neural connections are developing fast.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿的神经连接正在迅速发展。
words.en: Neural relates to a nerve or the nervous system.

words.tr: adj. 有才华的；有天赋的；
words.ex: He is a gifted musician who plays piano beautifully.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有才华的音乐家，钢琴弹得非常优美。
words.en: Having a natural ability or talent.

words.ex: His pursuit of happiness made him work hard every day.
words.ex_cn: 他对幸福的追求让他每天努力工作。
words.en: The act of pursuing something or someone, especially in order to catch or achieve them.

words.ex: He counted the coins with his fingers.
words.ex_cn: 他用手指数硬币。
words.en: Fingers are the long thin parts on the end of your hand that you use to hold things.

words.ex: The victims were helped by volunteers.
words.ex_cn: 受害者得到了志愿者的帮助。
words.en: A victim is someone who has been hurt or killed by someone or something, or someone who has suffered because of a bad situation.

words.ex: The barber knows his clients well.
words.ex_cn: 这位理发师很了解他的客户。
words.en: A client is someone who receives services from a professional person or organization in return for payment.

words.ex: Rain implies wet streets.
words.ex_cn: 下雨意味着街道会湿。
words.en: If something implies something else, it strongly suggests that it is the case.

words.tr: adj. 剧增的；高耸云霄的； v. “soar”的现在分词；
words.ex: The soaring prices made people angry.
words.ex_cn: 剧增的价格让人们感到愤怒。
words.en: If something such as a bird soars into the air, it goes quickly and smoothly upwards.

words.ex: He has two siblings, a brother and a sister.
words.ex_cn: 他有两个兄弟姐妹，一个哥哥和一个妹妹。
words.en: Your brothers and sisters are your siblings.

words.ex: The store sells seasonal fruits like strawberries in spring.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店在春天出售草莓等季节性水果。
words.en: Seasonal means relating to or happening during a particular season.

words.tr:
n. 合同；契约；
v. 收缩；
words.ex: They signed a contract to buy the house.
words.ex_cn: 他们签署了一份购买房子的合同。
words.en: A contract is a legal agreement between two or more parties. It can also mean to become smaller or tighter, or to catch a disease.

words.ex: The minority group voted for change.
words.ex_cn: 少数群体投票支持变革。
words.en: A minority is a group of people within a community or country who are different from the majority of the people there in race, religion, or political beliefs.

words.ex: The sun shines on the crystals and makes them sparkle.
words.ex_cn: 阳光照在晶体上，使它们闪闪发光。
words.en: Crystals are solid materials whose constituents (such as atoms, molecules, or ions) are arranged in a highly ordered microscopic structure, forming a crystal lattice that extends in all directions.

words.ex: We should conserve water in daily life.
words.ex_cn: 我们应在日常生活中节约用水。
words.en: To conserve something means to protect it from harm, loss, or change, especially in order to preserve it for the future.

words.tr: v. 觅食；给……提供食物（forage 的现在分词...；
words.ex: Birds are foraging for worms in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在花园里觅食虫子。
words.en: Foraging is the act of searching for food or provisions.

words.tr: adj. 专注的；专用的；献身的； v. 奉献；“dedicate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is dedicated to his studies.
words.ex_cn: 他专注于学习。
words.en: If you say that someone is dedicated to something, you approve of the fact that they have committed to it and are willing to give a lot of time and energy to it.

words.ex: He ate a piece of chocolate after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后吃了一块巧克力。
words.en: A food preparation in the form of a paste or solid block made from roasted and ground cacao seeds, typically sweetened.

words.tr: v. 完成；满足；“fulfill”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 满足的；
words.ex: He fulfilled his promise to help.
words.ex_cn: 他履行了帮助的承诺。
words.en: If you feel fulfilled, you feel happy and satisfied because you are doing something that fully uses your abilities and qualities.

words.ex: The observers watched the game quietly.
words.ex_cn: 观察者们安静地观看了比赛。
words.en: People who watch and pay attention to something, especially in order to learn or understand it.

words.ex: The wound caused a serious infection.
words.ex_cn: 伤口引起了严重的感染。
words.en: An infection is a disease caused by microorganisms such as bacteria, viruses, or parasites invading the body.

words.tr: adj. 加强的； v. 增强；“reinforce”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The concrete wall is reinforced with steel bars.
words.ex_cn: 这堵混凝土墙用钢筋加固了。
words.en: To reinforce something means to make it stronger or more able to withstand pressure, especially by adding extra material or support.

words.tr: adj. 盛行的；有优势的；普遍的； v. “prevail”的现在分词；
words.ex: The prevailing weather today is sunny.
words.ex_cn: 今天盛行的天气是晴天。
words.en: The prevailing thing in a particular place or at a particular time is the one that is most common or strongest at that place or time.

words.tr: n. 收集者；收藏家；“collector”的复数；
words.ex: Collectors buy old coins and stamps.
words.ex_cn: 收集者购买旧硬币和邮票。
words.en: Collectors are people who collect things of a particular type as a hobby or for investment.

words.ex: Pop music is part of the mainstream.
words.ex_cn: 流行音乐是主流的一部分。
words.en: The ideas, attitudes, or activities that are shared by most people and regarded as normal or conventional.

words.tr:
n. 纪律；学科；科目；训练；惩戒；
v. 约束自己；
words.ex: The teacher enforced discipline in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 老师在教室里维持纪律。
words.en: Discipline is the practice of making people obey rules or standards of behaviour, and punishing them when they do not.

words.tr: v. 分类；“classify”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The librarian classified the books by subject.
words.ex_cn: 图书管理员按主题对书籍进行分类。
words.en: Officially designated as secret and accessible only to authorized personnel.

words.ex: Five apples constitute a basket.
words.ex_cn: 五个苹果构成一篮子。
words.en: If something constitutes a particular thing, it can be regarded as being that thing.

words.ex: The extraction of coal harms the environment.
words.ex_cn: 煤炭的开采对环境有害。
words.en: The process of removing or obtaining something from something else.

words.ex: The adaptation of animals to cold weather is amazing.
words.ex_cn: 动物对寒冷天气的适应令人惊叹。
words.en: An adaptation is a film, television drama, or stage play that is based on a written work.

words.tr: v. 发音；宣告；“pronounce”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 显著的；
words.ex: He pronounced the word correctly.
words.ex_cn: 他正确地发音了这个单词。
words.en: Something that is pronounced is very noticeable or obvious.

words.ex: His profession is a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他的职业是教师。
words.en: A profession is a type of job that requires advanced education or training.

words.tr: adj. 易接近的；可使用的；简单易懂的；可进入的；
words.ex: The park is accessible by bus.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园乘公交车可达。
words.en: If a place or building is accessible to people, it is easy for them to reach it or get into it. If an object is accessible, it is easy to reach.

words.tr: adj. 令人惊讶的；惊人的； v. “astonish”的现在分词；
words.ex: The magician did an astonishing trick.
words.ex_cn: 魔术师表演了一个令人惊讶的魔术。
words.en: If something is astonishing, it is very surprising.

words.tr:
adj. 中断的；
v. 打断；中断；
words.ex: The interrupted signal made the call drop.
words.ex_cn: 中断的信号导致通话断了。
words.en: If something is interrupted, it is stopped or paused, especially because of an unexpected event.

words.ex: Farmers use fertilisers to help plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用化肥来帮助植物生长。
words.en: Fertilisers are substances added to soil to improve its fertility and promote plant growth.

words.tr: adj. 压倒的；无法抗拒的；势不可挡的； v. “overwhelm”的现在分词；
words.ex: The crowd's cheers were overwhelming.
words.ex_cn: 人群的欢呼声压倒了一切。
words.en: If something is overwhelming, it affects you very strongly, and you do not know how to deal with it.

words.tr: adv. 连续地；不断地；连续不断地；
words.ex: The machine works continuously without stopping.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器连续工作，不停止。
words.en: Without interruption; constantly.

words.ex: The effectiveness of the new medicine was proven in trials.
words.ex_cn: 这种新药的有效性在试验中得到了证实。
words.en: The ability to produce a desired or intended result.

words.tr: adj. 人与人之间的；人际关系的；
words.ex: Good interpersonal skills help people work together.
words.ex_cn: 良好的人际交往能力有助于人们合作。
words.en: relating to relationships or communication between people

words.ex: He kept putting off his homework because of procrastination.
words.ex_cn: 他因为拖延一直推迟做作业。
words.en: Procrastination is the action of delaying or postponing something.

words.ex: The coat is made of soft fur.
words.ex_cn: 这件外套是由柔软的毛皮制成的。
words.en: The thick hair that covers the bodies of some animals, or the hair-covered skin(s) of animals, used in making clothes and other items.

words.ex: The norm in this school is to arrive on time.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校的准则就是准时到校。
words.en: A norm is an official standard or level that organizations are expected to reach.

words.tr: n. 半挂车；（一侧与其他建筑相连的）半独立式的住宅
words.ex: The truck driver parked the semi near the warehouse.
words.ex_cn: 卡车司机把半挂车停在了仓库附近。
words.en: A semi is a trailer that is attached to the back of a truck and is used for transporting goods.

words.tr:
adj. 反对的
n. 反对者
words.ex: He is an anti-war activist.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个反对战争的活动家。
words.en: If someone is anti something, they are opposed to it.

words.ex: The army trains new soldiers every month.
words.ex_cn: 军队每个月训练新兵。
words.en: An army is a large organized group of people who are armed and trained to fight on land in a war.

words.tr: n. 全体船员；全体人员；
words.ex: The crew fixed the ship's engine during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 全体船员在风暴中修好了船的引擎。
words.en: A crew is a group of people who work on and operate a ship, aircraft, or train.

words.tr:
n. 外衣；大衣；
v. 覆盖；
words.ex: He put on his coat before going out.
words.ex_cn: 他出门前穿上了外衣。
words.en: A coat is a piece of clothing with long sleeves which you wear over your other clothes when you go outside.

words.tr:
n. 酸；
adj. 酸性的；
words.ex: The acid in lemon juice tastes sour.
words.ex_cn: 柠檬汁中的酸味道很酸。
words.en: An acid is a chemical substance, usually a liquid, which contains hydrogen and can react with other substances to form salts. Some acids burn or dissolve other substances that they come into contact with.

words.tr:
n. 洗涤槽；水槽；
v. （使）沉没；
words.ex: The dirty dishes are in the sink.
words.ex_cn: 脏盘子在水槽里。
words.en: If a boat sinks, or if something sinks it, it disappears below the surface of a mass of water.

words.ex: She sings a song every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上唱歌。
words.en: To produce musical sounds with the voice, especially words with a set tune.

words.tr:
n. 跳跃；
v. 跳跃；
words.ex: The cat made a big leap over the fence.
words.ex_cn: 猫跳过了篱笆。
words.en: To leap means to jump high or a long way, or to move quickly and with a lot of energy.

words.ex: The wolf howled at the moon.
words.ex_cn: 狼对着月亮嚎叫。
words.en: A wolf is a wild animal that is related to the dog and lives and hunts in groups.

words.ex: The upper shelf is too high to reach.
words.ex_cn: 上面的架子太高了，够不着。
words.en: Higher in place or position; situated above another part.

words.ex: He is prone to colds in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天容易感冒。
words.en: If you are prone to a particular problem or characteristic, you are likely to be affected by it or to have it.

words.ex: The boy will climb the tree to get the ball.
words.ex_cn: 男孩会爬树去拿球。
words.en: To climb means to go up something, such as a mountain or a ladder, usually with some effort.

words.tr: adj. 锋利的；骤变的；灵敏的；尖刻的；
words.ex: The knife is sharp enough to cut paper.
words.ex_cn: 这把刀足够锋利，可以切纸。
words.en: Having a thin edge or a fine point that is capable of cutting or piercing; keen.

words.ex: He stepped aside to let the bus pass.
words.ex_cn: 他走到一旁，让公交车通过。
words.en: If you move something aside, you move it to one side of you, usually because it is in the way.

words.ex: The outer door is locked, but the inner one is open.
words.ex_cn: 外门锁着，但内门是开着的。
words.en: Outer is used to describe something that is on the outside of something else.

words.ex: I visited my grandparents twice last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年我去了祖父母家两次。
words.en: Two times; on two occasions.

words.tr: v. 扫荡；打扫；掠过；“sweep”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The army swept the village to find hidden enemies.
words.ex_cn: 军队扫荡了村庄，寻找隐藏的敌人。
words.en: To clean an area by brushing away dirt or litter.

words.tr:
v. 微笑；
n. 微笑；
words.ex: I smile every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天微笑。
words.en: A smile is the expression that you have on your face when you are happy or amused, or when you are being friendly. When you smile, the corners of your mouth curve up and you sometimes show your teeth.

words.tr: n. 树干；大衣箱；象鼻子；
words.ex: The elephant held the branch with its trunk.
words.ex_cn: 大象用它的鼻子抓住树枝。
words.en: The main stem of a tree, below the branches, and above the ground; the main part of the body, excluding the head, arms, and legs; the long, flexible nose of an elephant; a large, strong box used for transporting or storing clothes and other personal possessions.

words.ex: The magician showed some magic tricks.
words.ex_cn: 魔术师表演了一些魔术把戏。
words.en: A trick is a clever or skillful action that someone does in order to entertain or deceive people.

words.tr: n. 潜水；跳水； v. 潜水；跳水；“dive”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves diving in the clear sea.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在清澈的海里潜水。
words.en: The sport or activity of swimming or exploring underwater.

words.tr:
v. 过滤；
n. 过滤器；
words.ex: She filters the water before drinking it.
words.ex_cn: 她在喝水之前过滤水。
words.en: A filter is a device or a method that removes unwanted substances from something such as water, air, or light, by passing it through a special material or system.

words.ex: The amazon flows through many countries in South America.
words.ex_cn: 亚马逊河穿过南美洲的许多国家。
words.en: The Amazon is a major river in South America, and it is also the name of the world's largest rainforest that surrounds the river. Additionally, Amazon is a global technology company focusing on e-commerce, cloud computing, digital streaming, and artificial intelligence.

words.tr: v. 丢弃；抛；“throw”的过去分词；
words.ex: He threw away the old book and was thrown it into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把那本旧书丢进了垃圾桶。
words.en: If you throw something, you send it through the air using your hand or arm.

words.ex: His humour makes everyone laugh.
words.ex_cn: 他的幽默让每个人都笑起来。
words.en: Humour is the quality of being amusing or comic, especially as expressed in literature or speech.

words.ex: The child behaves well in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子在课堂上表现得很好。
words.en: To behave means to act in a particular way, especially in a way that is good or correct.

words.tr: n. 独木舟；独木舟（canoe 的复数）；
words.ex: They paddled canoes down the river.
words.ex_cn: 他们划着独木舟顺流而下。
words.en: A canoe is a narrow, lightweight boat pointed at both ends and open on top, propelled by one or more seated or kneeling paddlers facing the direction of travel and using a single-bladed paddle.

words.ex: The lion lives in the jungle.
words.ex_cn: 狮子生活在丛林中。
words.en: A jungle is a dense, tropical forest that is home to a wide variety of plants and animals.

words.tr: v. 抽；喷涌出；“pump”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The pump pumped water from the well.
words.ex_cn: 水泵从井里抽水。
words.en: If someone is pumped, they are very excited or enthusiastic about something.

words.ex: We went to the cinema last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚去看了电影。
words.en: A cinema is a place where people go to watch films. It can also refer to the art and industry of making films.

words.ex: It is illegal to drive without a license.
words.ex_cn: 无证驾驶是非法的。
words.en: If something is illegal, the law says that it is not allowed.

words.tr:
n. 最大限度；最大量；
adj. 最大极限的；最多的；
words.ex: The maximum of the crowd is 100 people.
words.ex_cn: 人群的上限是100人。
words.en: The greatest or highest amount possible or attained.

words.tr:
n. （木材）采运作业；
v. 把……载入正式记录；
words.ex: The company increased its logging in the northern forest.
words.ex_cn: 该公司增加了在北部森林的木材采运作业。
words.en: The activity or business of felling trees and cutting and preparing the timber.

words.ex: The editing of the book took three months.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的编辑花了三个月。
words.en: The process of revising and preparing a written, recorded, or filmed material for publication or presentation.

words.tr: n. 一段时间；会议；会期；开庭；学年；
words.ex: We had a long session of studying together.
words.ex_cn: 我们一起学习了一段时间。
words.en: A session is a meeting of a court, parliament, or other official group, or a period of time used for a particular activity, especially by a group of people.

words.ex: Steve Jobs is the founder of Apple.
words.ex_cn: 史蒂夫·乔布斯是苹果公司的创办者。
words.en: A founder is someone who establishes an organization, company, or institution. As a verb, it means to fail or collapse, especially in terms of a plan or a ship sinking.

words.ex: He insists on going alone.
words.ex_cn: 他坚持要一个人去。
words.en: If you insist on something, you demand it and refuse to accept any alternative.

words.ex: The playful puppy chased its tail.
words.ex_cn: 那只爱玩耍的小狗追着自己的尾巴跑。
words.en: Someone who is playful is full of fun and likes to play.

words.tr:
prep. 除…以外；
adv. 此外；
words.ex: Besides apples, he likes oranges.
words.ex_cn: 除了苹果，他还喜欢橙子。
words.en: In addition to; apart from.

words.tr:
adj. 立即的；即时的；
n. 瞬间；立即；
words.ex: He wants an instant answer.
words.ex_cn: 他想要一个立即的回答。
words.en: An instant is a very short period of time, or a particular point in time.

words.ex: He is a skilled carpenter.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名有技能的木匠。
words.en: Having the ability and experience to do something well.

words.ex: His absence of interest made the teacher sad.
words.ex_cn: 他对学习的缺乏兴趣让老师感到难过。
words.en: The state of being away from a place or person.

words.tr: v. 设计；发明；想出；想出( devise的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He devised a simple plan to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他设计了一个简单的计划来解决问题。
words.en: If you devise a plan, system, or machine, you have the idea for it and design it.

words.ex: It is evident that he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 很明显他很累。
words.en: If something is evident, it is easy to see, perceive, or understand.

words.ex: Birds live in the wetlands near the river.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类生活在河边的湿地里。
words.en: Wetlands are areas of land where the soil is saturated with moisture, such as swamps and marshes, which are vital for biodiversity and environmental health.

words.ex: He was born in the province of Guangdong.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在广东省。
words.en: A province is a large area of a country that has its own administration and often its own culture.

words.tr:
adj. 军事的；军用的；
n. 军队；武装力量；
words.ex: The military base is near the border.
words.ex_cn: 军事基地靠近边境。
words.en: relating to or characteristic of soldiers or armed forces

words.ex: He spent his lifetime teaching children.
words.ex_cn: 他一生都在教孩子们。
words.en: The period of time during which an individual is alive.

words.tr: n. 攀爬；爬升； v. 攀爬；爬升；“climb”的现在分词；
words.ex: Climbing is his favorite outdoor activity.
words.ex_cn: 攀爬是他最喜欢的户外活动。
words.en: Climbing is the activity of climbing up something, especially mountains or rocks, often as a sport or hobby.

words.tr: n. 可能发生的情况；设想；
words.ex: It's a possible scenario that it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天会下雨是一个可能发生的情况。
words.en: A scenario is a description of a possible course of action or events.

words.ex: The castle is a medieval building.
words.ex_cn: 这座城堡是一座中世纪的建筑。
words.en: Relating to the Middle Ages, the period in European history from about the 5th century to the 15th century.

words.ex: The town built shelters for people during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 镇上为人们在风暴期间建造了避难所。
words.en: A shelter is a small building or covered place which is made to protect people from bad weather or danger.

words.ex: The farm has 50 hectares of land.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场有50公顷土地。
words.en: A metric unit of area equal to 10,000 square meters, commonly used for measuring land.

words.tr: v. 描绘；描绘，描画( depict的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The painting depicted a quiet lake at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画描绘了日落时宁静的湖面。
words.en: To depict someone or something means to show or represent them in a work of art such as a drawing or painting.

words.tr: v. 欢迎；表示对某人或某事的热情接纳；
words.ex: They welcomed the new students with smiles.
words.ex_cn: 他们微笑着欢迎新生。
words.en: If you welcome someone, you greet them in a friendly way when they arrive somewhere.

words.ex: She eats fruits to get vitamins.
words.ex_cn: 她吃水果来获取维生素。
words.en: Vitamins are substances that are found in foods and are necessary for normal growth and health.

words.tr: adj. 吸引人的；诱人的； v. “tempt”的现在分词；
words.ex: The smell of fresh bread is very tempting.
words.ex_cn: 新鲜面包的香味非常诱人。
words.en: If something is tempting, it makes you feel that you want to have it or do it.

words.tr: n. 乐观；乐观主义；乐观精神；
words.ex: His optimism helps him stay happy even when things are hard.
words.ex_cn: 他的乐观让他即使在困难时也能保持快乐。
words.en: Optimism is a feeling of hopefulness and confidence about the future or the success of something.

words.ex: The bright light stimulated her eyes.
words.ex_cn: 强烈的光线刺激了她的眼睛。
words.en: To stimulate something means to encourage it to begin or develop further.

words.tr: n. 威斯康星州（美国中西部的一个州）
words.ex: He lives in Wisconsin.
words.ex_cn: 他住在威斯康星州。
words.en: A state in the northern United States, known for its dairy farming and cheese production.

words.tr: adj. 突出的；杰出的；显著的；
words.ex: He is a prominent scientist in the field of medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他是医学领域的一位突出的科学家。
words.en: Someone or something that is prominent is important and well-known, or is positioned in a way that makes them easily seen or noticed.

words.tr: n. 爆炸；（感情）爆发；激增；
words.ex: The explosion broke all the windows.
words.ex_cn: 爆炸震碎了所有的窗户。
words.en: An explosion is a sudden, violent burst of energy, for example one caused by a bomb.

words.ex: He overcame many obstacles to finish the race.
words.ex_cn: 他克服了许多障碍，完成了比赛。
words.en: An obstacle is something which makes it difficult for you to go forward or to achieve something.

words.tr: adj. 中等的；次要的；第二的；
words.ex: He attends a secondary school in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他在城里上一所中学。
words.en: If you describe something as secondary, you mean that it is less important than something else.

words.tr: adj. 优秀的；杰出的；卓越的；
words.ex: He got an excellent score on the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中取得了优异的成绩。
words.en: Something that is excellent is very good indeed.

words.tr: n. 生态学家；生态学者；
words.ex: The ecologist studied birds in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这位生态学家研究了森林里的鸟类。
words.en: An ecologist is a scientist who studies the relationships between living things and their environment.

words.ex: The teacher said the answer is acceptable.
words.ex_cn: 老师说这个答案是可以接受的。
words.en: Something that is acceptable is satisfactory or good enough to be allowed or approved of.

words.tr: n. 孩子；年轻人；少年；孩子( youngster的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The youngsters play soccer after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后踢足球。
words.en: Youngsters are young people, especially children or teenagers.

words.ex: The earthquake caused tremendous damage.
words.ex_cn: 地震造成了巨大的破坏。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as tremendous, you mean that they are very great in amount, extent, or intensity.

words.ex: The global climate conference was held in Paris.
words.ex_cn: 全球气候大会在巴黎举行。
words.en: A conference is a meeting of people who share the same interests or profession.

words.tr: v. 促进；使便利；使容易；
words.ex: The teacher facilitates learning by asking questions.
words.ex_cn: 老师通过提问来促进学习。
words.en: To make an action or process easier or more likely to happen.

words.tr:
n. 淡水；
adj. 淡水的；
words.ex: Fish live in freshwater lakes.
words.ex_cn: 鱼生活在淡水湖中。
words.en: Freshwater refers to water that is not salty, especially water in rivers and lakes.

words.ex: The percentage of students who passed the test was 85.
words.ex_cn: 通过考试的学生百分比是85。
words.en: A percentage is a proportion or ratio expressed as a fraction of 100.

words.ex: The book is reasonably expensive.
words.ex_cn: 这本书相当地贵。
words.en: In a fair and sensible way; to a moderate or acceptable degree.

words.ex: Farmers use irrigation to water their crops.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用灌溉来浇灌庄稼。
words.en: Irrigation is the process of supplying water to land or crops to help growth, typically by means of channels.

words.tr: adj. 毁灭性的； v. “devastate”的现在分词；
words.ex: The earthquake caused devastating damage to the city.
words.ex_cn: 地震对这座城市造成了毁灭性的破坏。
words.en: If you describe something as devastating, you are emphasizing that it is very harmful or damaging.

words.ex: There was a controversy about the new school rules.
words.ex_cn: 关于新校规，人们展开了争论。
words.en: A controversy is a disagreement or argument about something that involves many people and generates strong feelings.

words.tr: adj. 欧洲大陆的；大陆的；
words.ex: He prefers continental breakfast with bread and coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他更喜欢欧洲大陆式的早餐，有面包和咖啡。
words.en: Continental is used to describe something that relates to or is characteristic of a continent, especially the mainland of Europe as distinct from the British Isles.

words.ex: The philosopher wrote a book about life.
words.ex_cn: 这位哲学家写了一本关于生活的书。
words.en: A philosopher is a person who studies or writes about philosophy.

words.ex: The weather was predictable today, just like yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气和昨天一样，是可以预见的。
words.en: If you say that an event or a situation is predictable, you mean that it is obvious in advance that it will happen or what it will be like.

words.ex: He works hard to earn his subsistence.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以维持生计。
words.en: Subsistence is the condition of just having enough food or money to stay alive.

words.ex: The new plan incorporates feedback from students.
words.ex_cn: 新计划包含了学生的反馈。
words.en: If one thing incorporates another thing, it includes the other thing.

words.ex: The forest has high biodiversity.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林生物多样性很高。
words.en: Biodiversity refers to the variety of life in the world or in a particular habitat or ecosystem.

words.ex: The scientist made a breakthrough in cancer research.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家在癌症研究中取得了突破。
words.en: A breakthrough is a significant development or achievement that helps to solve a problem or improve a situation.

words.ex: The study uses quantitative data to measure results.
words.ex_cn: 这项研究使用定量数据来测量结果。
words.en: Relating to, measuring, or measured by the quantity of something rather than its quality.

words.ex: He felt satisfaction after finishing his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他完成作业后感到满意。
words.en: The feeling of pleasure that you have when you do or get something that you wanted or needed.

words.ex: The practitioners are learning how to treat patients in the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 这些实习者正在医院学习如何治疗病人。
words.en: A practitioner is a person who regularly does a particular activity, especially one that requires skill.

words.ex: Climbing the mountain without oxygen was a great feat.
words.ex_cn: 在不吸氧的情况下爬山是一项伟大的壮举。
words.en: A feat is an act or achievement that shows great courage, skill, or strength.

words.ex: The band is playing music.
words.ex_cn: 这个乐队在演奏音乐。
words.en: A band is a group of musicians who play music together, especially popular music. It can also refer to a strip of material used for binding or decoration, or a range of frequencies or wavelengths in a spectrum.

words.tr:
prep. 加；加上；
conj. 加；和；并且；
n. 优势；
words.ex: Five plus three is eight.
words.ex_cn: 五加三等于八。
words.en: Used to indicate addition, or a positive quality or factor.

words.ex: He used a thin wire to fix the broken hook.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根细金属丝固定了坏掉的钩子。
words.en: A wire is a long thin piece of metal that is used to fasten things or to carry electric current.

words.ex: The frogs jump near the pond.
words.ex_cn: 青蛙在池塘边跳跃。
words.en: Frogs are small, tailless amphibians with a short body, protruding eyes, and the ability to leap.

words.tr: n. 一餐；一顿饭；“meal”的复数；
words.ex: We eat three meals a day.
words.ex_cn: 我们一天吃三餐。
words.en: A meal is an occasion when people sit down to eat food, especially breakfast, lunch, or dinner.

words.ex: He brushed his teeth every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上刷牙。
words.en: The hard, white objects in the mouth that are used for biting and chewing.

words.ex: Fish live among the reefs near the island.
words.ex_cn: 鱼生活在岛屿附近的礁石中。
words.en: A reef is a ridge of jagged rock, coral, or sand just above or below the surface of the sea.

words.ex: He is obese because he eats too much junk food.
words.ex_cn: 他因为吃太多垃圾食品而肥胖。
words.en: If someone is obese, they are extremely fat.

words.tr: n. 专家咨询组；嵌板；仪器板；
words.ex: The government formed a panel to advise on health policy.
words.ex_cn: 政府组建了一个专家咨询组来就卫生政策提供建议。
words.en: A panel is a small group of people who are chosen to do something, for example to discuss something in public or to make a decision.

words.ex: The bridge is made of steel.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥是用钢建造的。
words.en: Steel is a very strong metal made mainly from iron. It is used for making many things such as bridges, buildings, and vehicles.

words.ex: The hotel has a five-star grade.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店有五星级别的等级。
words.en: A grade is a level of quality, rank, or value, or a mark given in an examination or for school work.

words.ex: He finally admit his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他终于承认了自己的错误。
words.en: If you admit that something bad, unpleasant, or embarrassing is true, you agree, often unwillingly, that it is true.

words.tr:
adj. 空的；无意义的；
v. 倒空；
words.ex: The box is empty.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子是空的。
words.en: If you describe a place, object, or person as empty, you mean that they contain nothing or have no special qualities, and are therefore not interesting or useful.

words.ex: The book has a long title.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有一个很长的标题。
words.en: A title is a name that describes someone's position or job, or a word or phrase that is used to describe a book, film, play, etc.

words.ex: The fish is still alive in the water.
words.ex_cn: 这条鱼还在水里活着。
words.en: If people or animals are alive, they are not dead.

words.ex: Farmers grow grain like wheat and rice.
words.ex_cn: 农民种植小麦和大米等谷物。
words.en: A grain is a small, hard seed of a food plant such as wheat, rice, or corn, or the plant itself.

words.ex: He walks on the trails every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上在小径上散步。
words.en: Trails can refer to marks left by the passage of someone or something, or paths through rough country.

words.tr: n. 中风；划水动作；一击；
words.ex: He had a stroke last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年中风了。
words.en: A stroke is a medical condition in which poor blood flow to the brain results in cell death. It can also refer to an act of hitting or striking someone or something, or a gentle movement of the hand over a surface.

words.ex: The viewer watched the movie on TV.
words.ex_cn: 观看者在电视上看了这部电影。
words.en: A viewer is someone who watches something, especially television.

words.tr: n. 奢华；奢侈品；难得的享受；
words.ex: She bought a luxury dress for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一件奢华的裙子。
words.en: Luxury is very great comfort, especially among beautiful and expensive surroundings.

words.ex: The doctor examined the tissue under a microscope.
words.ex_cn: 医生在显微镜下检查了组织。
words.en: Tissue is a group of cells that have a similar structure and that work together to perform a specific function.

words.tr:
n. 预算；预算金额；
adj. 廉价的；花钱少的；
v. 为 ... 做预算；
words.ex: We made a budget for our vacation.
words.ex_cn: 我们为旅行制定了一个预算。
words.en: A budget is a plan that shows how much money a person or organization will earn and how much they will need or be able to spend.

words.tr:
n. 激增；汹涌；
v. 激增；汹涌；
words.ex: There were surges in electricity use during heatwaves.
words.ex_cn: 在热浪期间，电力使用量激增。
words.en: A surge is a sudden and great increase in something, or a sudden and strong movement forward or upward.

words.ex: The buyers chose the cheapest products.
words.ex_cn: 买家们选择了最便宜的产品。
words.en: Buyers are individuals or organizations that purchase goods or services.

words.ex: She wore a dress made of cotton.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件棉质裙子。
words.en: Cotton is a plant that produces a soft fiber which is used to make cloth or thread. Cotton is also the cloth or thread that is made from this fiber.

words.tr:
adj. 紫色的；
n. 紫色；
words.ex: The flower is purple.
words.ex_cn: 这朵花是紫色的。
words.en: Purple is a color that is a mixture of red and blue.

words.ex: The new phone is too costly for me.
words.ex_cn: 这部新手机对我来说太贵了。
words.en: If you say that something is costly, you mean that it costs a lot of money, often more than you would want to pay.

words.ex: He recalls his childhood days with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着回忆起自己的童年时光。
words.en: If you recall something, you remember it and tell others about it. If a company recalls a product, it asks for it to be returned because there is something wrong with it.

words.ex: He loves reading science fiction.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读科幻小说。
words.en: Fiction refers to literature in the form of prose, especially novels, that describes imaginary events and people.

words.tr: adj. 已婚的； v. 结婚；“marry”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: They are married and have two children.
words.ex_cn: 他们已婚，有两个孩子。
words.en: Having a husband or wife; united in matrimony.

words.tr: adv. 以某种方式；不知何故；
words.ex: Somehow, he finished the race despite the injury.
words.ex_cn: 不知怎么的，他尽管受伤了还是完成了比赛。
words.en: You use somehow to say that you do not know or cannot say how something was done or will be done.

words.ex: The mountains look distant from here.
words.ex_cn: 从这里看，山显得很远。
words.en: If you describe something as distant, you mean that it is far away in space or time.

words.tr:
n. 金融；财务；
v. 提供资金；
words.ex: He works in finance in New York.
words.ex_cn: 他在纽约从事金融工作。
words.en: Finance is the management of large amounts of money, especially by governments or large companies.

words.tr: adj. 水生的；水栖的；水中的；
words.ex: The fish live in aquatic plants.
words.ex_cn: 这些鱼生活在水生植物中。
words.en: Relating to water; living in or near water or taking place in water.

words.ex: The sailors sailed the boat across the sea.
words.ex_cn: 水手们把船驶过了大海。
words.en: Sailors are people who work on ships, especially those who assist in the operation of the vessel.

words.ex: The essence of love is caring for others.
words.ex_cn: 爱的本质是关心他人。
words.en: The essence of something is its basic and most important characteristic which gives it its individual identity.

words.tr: n. 地平线；思想等的范围；眼界；
words.ex: The sun set below the horizon.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在地平线以下落山。
words.en: The horizon is the line at which the earth's surface and the sky appear to meet.

words.tr: n. 小块；斑；小块土地；小块( patch的名词复数 )；
words.ex: He put patches on his jeans.
words.ex_cn: 他在牛仔裤上缝了小块补丁。
words.en: A patch is a piece of material used to mend a hole or a weak spot in something. It can also refer to a small area of something that is different from the area around it.

words.tr: v. 拒绝；回绝；拒绝，回绝( refuse的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He refused to eat the broccoli.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝吃西兰花。
words.en: Politely or firmly declined to accept or do something.

words.ex: He eats eggs for protein.
words.ex_cn: 他吃鸡蛋来获取蛋白质。
words.en: Proteins are large, complex molecules that play many critical roles in the body. They are necessary for the structure, function, and regulation of the body's tissues and organs.

words.tr: n. 治疗；疗癒；愈合； v. “heal”的现在分词；
words.ex: The healing of the wound took two weeks.
words.ex_cn: 伤口的治疗花了两周时间。
words.en: The process of becoming healthy again, especially after a cut or other injury, or of making someone healthy again.

words.ex: The expense of the trip was higher than expected.
words.ex_cn: 这次旅行的费用比预期的要高。
words.en: An expense is the amount of money that you spend on something.

words.ex: The radio transmits music to listeners.
words.ex_cn: 收音机将音乐传递给听众。
words.en: To send or pass something from one person, place, or thing to another.

words.tr: v. 减到最少；使最小化；
words.ex: Try to minimise waste in your daily life.
words.ex_cn: 尽量减少日常生活中的浪费。
words.en: If you minimise a risk, problem, or unpleasant situation, you reduce it to the lowest possible level, or prevent it increasing beyond that level.

words.ex: Nowadays, many children use tablets to learn.
words.ex_cn: 现在，许多孩子用平板电脑学习。
words.en: At the present time, in contrast with the past.

words.tr: adj. 回收的； v. 再循环；“recycle”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He bought a recycled bottle for his water.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一个回收的瓶子来装水。
words.en: If something is recycled, it is used again after it has been used once, often by being treated in a special process.

words.tr:
n. 内部；
adj. 内部的；
words.ex: The interior of the house is very cozy.
words.ex_cn: 房子的内部非常舒适。
words.en: The interior of something is the inside part of it.

words.ex: He attends three lectures every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周上三节讲课。
words.en: Lectures are talks that are given to a group of people to teach them about a particular subject, often as part of a university or college course.

words.tr: n. 历史遗迹；纪念碑；不朽作品；
words.ex: The ancient monument attracts many tourists each year.
words.ex_cn: 这座古代历史遗迹每年吸引许多游客。
words.en: A monument is a large structure, usually made of stone, which is built to remind people of an important person or event.

words.ex: You should believe in yourself.
words.ex_cn: 你应该相信自己。
words.en: Used to refer to the person being addressed as the object of a verb or preposition when they are also the subject of the clause.

words.ex: Call me whenever you need help.
words.ex_cn: 无论何时你需要帮助，就给我打电话。
words.en: at any or every time that

words.tr: v. 安排；“arrange”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 安排的；
words.ex: They arranged a meeting for tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们安排了明天的会议。
words.en: If you arrange an event or meeting, you make plans for it to happen.

words.tr:
v. 注册；登记；
n. 登记簿；
words.ex: He will register for the course next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会注册这门课程。
words.en: If you register something, you officially record it or list it.

words.tr: v. 繁荣兴旺；茁壮成长；
words.ex: The business flourishes in the new market.
words.ex_cn: 这家企业在新市场中繁荣兴旺。
words.en: If something flourishes, it is successful, active, or common, and developing quickly and strongly.

words.tr: v. 批准；“approve”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 经核准的；被认可的；
words.ex: The teacher approved my project.
words.ex_cn: 老师批准了我的项目。
words.en: If something is approved, it has been officially agreed to or accepted.

words.ex: He complains about the loud noise every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都抱怨噪音太大。
words.en: To express dissatisfaction, pain, or resentment, usually because of a particular situation or someone's actions.

words.tr:
adv. 在海外；在国外；
adj. 海外的；
words.ex: He moved overseas for work.
words.ex_cn: 他为了工作搬到了海外。
words.en: If something is overseas, it is in a foreign country, usually separated from your own country by an ocean.

words.ex: The aircraft landed safely at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 这架航空器在机场安全着陆。
words.en: An aircraft is a vehicle which can fly, for example an aeroplane or a helicopter.

words.ex: She wore a dress for the occasion.
words.ex_cn: 她为了这个特殊场合穿了一条裙子。
words.en: An occasion is a particular time when something happens, or a special event.

words.tr: n. 自主权；自治权；自治；
words.ex: The region demands autonomy from the central government.
words.ex_cn: 该地区要求从中央政府获得自主权。
words.en: Autonomy is the ability or condition of being self-governing; independence in one's thoughts or actions.

words.ex: He paid the deposits for the apartment.
words.ex_cn: 他支付了公寓的押金。
words.en: 1. A sum of money placed or kept in a bank account, usually to gain interest. 2. A layer or body of accumulated matter.

words.ex: This district has many parks and schools.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区有许多公园和学校。
words.en: A district is a part of a city, country, or other area that has been officially designated for a particular purpose, such as administration or business.

words.tr: adj. 了解情况的； v. 通知；告知；“inform”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is an informed voter who reads the news daily.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个了解情况的选民，每天阅读新闻。
words.en: If someone is informed, they know a lot about a particular subject or situation.

words.ex: The volcanoes erupted last year.
words.ex_cn: 这些火山去年喷发了。
words.en: A volcano is a mountain that opens downward to a pool of molten rock below the surface of the earth. When pressure builds up, eruptions occur.

words.tr: v. 两件或更多的事情同时发生；想法、意见等相同；两件或更多的事情同时发生( coincide的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The meeting coincided with the rainstorm.
words.ex_cn: 会议与暴雨同时发生。
words.en: If one event coincides with another, they happen at the same time. If ideas or opinions coincide, they are the same or very similar.

words.ex: He goes to libraries to read books.
words.ex_cn: 他去图书馆读书。
words.en: A place where books, magazines, and other materials (such as videos and musical recordings) are available for people to use or borrow.

words.ex: The team comprises five players and two coaches.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队包括五名球员和两名教练。
words.en: Consists of or is made up of specific parts or elements.

words.ex: The company made a statement about the new policy.
words.ex_cn: 公司就新政策发布了一项声明。
words.en: A statement is something that you say or write which gives information in a formal or definite way.

words.tr: adj. 分散的；散落的； v. 散布；分散；“scatter”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The books were scattered on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 书散落在地板上。
words.en: If something is scattered, it is spread out or distributed over a wide area in an irregular way.

words.ex: He loves geography and learns about countries and rivers.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢地理学，学习各国和河流的知识。
words.en: The study of the physical features of the earth and its atmosphere, and of human activity as it affects and is affected by these, including the distribution of populations and resources, land use, and industries.

words.tr: v. 设想；构想；怀孕；想出；想出( conceive的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He conceived a new plan to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他设想了一个新的省钱计划。
words.en: To conceive means to form or devise a plan or idea in the mind, or to become pregnant.

words.ex: The investor gave money to the new business.
words.ex_cn: 这位投资者为这家新企业提供了资金。
words.en: An investor is a person or organization that puts money into financial schemes, property, etc. with the expectation of achieving a profit.

words.tr: n. 分子( molecule的名词复数 )
words.ex: Water is made of two hydrogen molecules and one oxygen molecule.
words.ex_cn: 水由两个氢分子和一个氧分子组成。
words.en: A molecule is the smallest particle in a chemical element or compound that has the chemical properties of that element or compound. Molecules are made up of atoms that are held together by chemical bonds.

words.ex: The prolonged rain caused flooding.
words.ex_cn: 持久的降雨引发了洪水。
words.en: Something that is prolonged continues for a long time, or longer than expected.

words.ex: The economist predicts higher prices next year.
words.ex_cn: 这位经济学家预测明年价格会上涨。
words.en: An economist is a person who studies, teaches, or writes about economics.

words.tr:
adj. 特别受喜爱的；
n. 特别喜爱的事物；
words.ex: Chocolate is my favourite dessert.
words.ex_cn: 巧克力是我最喜爱的甜点。
words.en: Something or someone that is preferred above all others.

words.tr: adv. 似乎；看似；表面上看；
words.ex: He is seemingly calm, but he is nervous inside.
words.ex_cn: 他似乎很平静，但内心很紧张。
words.en: appearing to be true or real but not necessarily so

words.ex: He walked alongside the river.
words.ex_cn: 他沿着河边走。
words.en: If one thing is alongside another thing, the first thing is next to the second.

words.tr: v. 居住于；栖息；“inhabit”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The island is inhabited by a small community.
words.ex_cn: 这个岛屿上住着一个小社区。
words.en: If a place or region is inhabited by a group of people or a species of animal, those people or animals live there.

words.tr: v. 发起；开始；开始( initiate的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He initiated a new project last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月发起了一项新计划。
words.en: To initiate something means to start it or cause it to happen.

words.tr: v. 规定；开药方；“prescribe”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 规定的；法定的；
words.ex: The doctor prescribed medicine for the cough.
words.ex_cn: 医生规定了治疗咳嗽的药物。
words.en: If a doctor prescribes medicine or treatment for you, he or she tells you what medicine or treatment to have.

words.ex: Sugar is an ingredient in this cake.
words.ex_cn: 糖是这个蛋糕的一个成分。
words.en: An ingredient is one of the substances that are combined to make something, especially in cooking.

words.ex: The withdrawal of the offer surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 撤销这项提议让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: The act of removing or taking something away, especially money from a bank account, or the process of stopping taking a drug or medicine.

words.tr:
adj. 集体的；
n. 集体；
words.ex: The collective decision was made by all members.
words.ex_cn: 这个集体决定是由所有成员做出的。
words.en: done or shared by all members of a group of people

words.tr: adj. 积极从事的；从事某种职业的；
words.ex: He is a practising doctor who helps many patients.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位积极从事医疗工作的医生，帮助了许多病人。
words.en: Engaged in a specified profession or occupation, especially on a regular basis.

words.ex: The regulatory agency checks food safety.
words.ex_cn: 监管机构检查食品安全。
words.en: Relating to the regulation of something, especially by the government.

words.ex: The fence shows the boundaries of the yard.
words.ex_cn: 这道篱笆显示了院子的边界。
words.en: A boundary is a real or imagined line that marks the edge or limit of something.

words.ex: He made a commitment to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺按时完成这个项目。
words.en: A commitment is something that regularly takes up some of your time because of an agreement you have made or because of responsibilities that you have.

words.ex: He has a good reputation for honesty.
words.ex_cn: 他以诚实著称。
words.en: The opinion that people have about someone or something because of what has happened in the past.

words.ex: The town uses geothermal energy to heat homes.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇利用地热能为房屋供暖。
words.en: Geothermal refers to the heat that comes from the sub-surface of the earth. It is contained in the rocks and fluids beneath the earth's crust and can be found as far down as to the earth's hot molten rock, magma.

words.tr: adj. 引起烦恼的；令人不安的； v. 打扰；妨碍；“disturb”的现在分词；
words.ex: The movie showed a disturbing scene of violence.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影展示了一个引起烦恼的暴力场景。
words.en: If you describe something as disturbing, you mean that it makes you feel anxious or upset.

words.tr: adj. 专门的；专业的； v. “specialize”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He has a specialized job in computer repair.
words.ex_cn: 他的工作是专门修理电脑的。
words.en: Requiring or involving detailed and specific knowledge or training.

words.ex: His descendants still live in the same village.
words.ex_cn: 他的后代仍然住在同一个村庄里。
words.en: A person's descendants are all the people who are born after them in their family, including their children, grandchildren, and so on.

words.tr: adj. 卓越的；杰出的；罕见的；特别的；
words.ex: She is an exceptional student who always gets top grades.
words.ex_cn: 她是一名卓越的学生，总是取得最高分。
words.en: An exceptional person or thing has some unusual quality or ability that makes them different from others.

words.ex: This chair is very comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子非常舒适。
words.en: If a piece of furniture or an item of clothing is comfortable, it makes you feel physically relaxed when you use it or wear it, for example because it is soft.

words.ex: Smoking is detrimental to your health.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟对你的健康有害。
words.en: Something that is detrimental has a harmful or damaging effect on something else.

words.tr: n. 约束；限制；拘束；“constraint”的复数；
words.ex: The budget puts constraints on our spending.
words.ex_cn: 预算对我们的支出施加了限制。
words.en: Constraints are things that limit or restrict what you can do.

words.ex: He uses this park exclusively for walking.
words.ex_cn: 他只在这个公园散步。
words.en: If you do something exclusively, you do it only in the way mentioned, and not in any other way.

words.tr: v. 给予；管理( administer的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The nurse administered the medicine to the patient.
words.ex_cn: 护士给病人服用了药物。
words.en: To manage or oversee the operation or performance of something; to give or apply (a remedy, etc.).

words.ex: The water supply is insufficient for the whole village.
words.ex_cn: 供水对整个村庄来说是不充分的。
words.en: If something is insufficient, it is not enough for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The map shows geographical features like mountains and rivers.
words.ex_cn: 这张地图显示了山脉和河流等地貌特征。
words.en: Relating to the study of the physical features of the earth and its atmosphere, and of human activity as it affects and is affected by these, including the distribution of populations and resources, land use, and industries.

words.ex: The establishment of the school took five years.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校的建立花了五年时间。
words.en: The act of establishing something or the state of being established. It can also refer to an organization or institution, especially a business or public body.

words.ex: His pronunciation of English words is very clear.
words.ex_cn: 他英语单词的发音非常清晰。
words.en: The way in which a word or a language is spoken.

words.ex: He underestimated the difficulty of the test.
words.ex_cn: 他低估了考试的难度。
words.en: If you underestimate something, you do not realize how large, great, or serious it is.

words.tr: n. 修改；变更；改进；“modification”的复数；
words.ex: The teacher made some modifications to the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师对试卷做了一些修改。
words.en: Changes made to something in order to improve it or make it more suitable for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The weather is unpredictable today.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气不可预测。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as unpredictable, you mean that you cannot tell what they are going to do or how they are going to behave.

words.ex: The teacher gave a simple interpretation of the poem.
words.ex_cn: 老师对这首诗做了一个简单的解释。
words.en: An interpretation of something is an explanation or understanding of it.

words.tr:
n. 传记；个人简历
abbr. 传记；“biography”的缩写
words.ex: The actor gave me his bio before the interview.
words.ex_cn: 这位演员在采访前给了我他的传记。
words.en: Short for biology or biography, referring to the study of living organisms or the written history of a person's life.

words.tr: n. 损失；伤亡人数；通行费；
words.ex: The war caused a heavy toll on innocent people.
words.ex_cn: 战争给平民带来了巨大的损失。
words.en: A toll is a small sum of money that you have to pay in order to use a particular bridge or road. / A toll is the total number of deaths, accidents, or disasters that occur in a particular period of time. / When a bell tolls, it rings slowly and repeatedly, often as a sign that someone has died.

words.ex: The child hurt his limb while playing.
words.ex_cn: 孩子玩耍时伤到了肢体。
words.en: A limb is one of the jointed appendages of an animal used for locomotion or grasping: arm; leg; wing; flipper.

words.ex: He ate a bowl of beans for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了一碗豆子。
words.en: A bean is a seed from one of several genera of the flowering plant family Fabaceae, which are used for human or animal food.

words.ex: The doctor gave him a small dose of medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生给了他一小剂量的药。
words.en: A dose of a medicine or a drug is the amount of it that you take at one time, or the amount that is recommended for you to take.

words.ex: The teacher showed a bias for students who arrived early.
words.ex_cn: 老师对早到的学生有偏爱。
words.en: If someone is biased, they prefer one group of people to another, and behave unfairly as a result.

words.tr: adj. 充满智慧的；明智的；英明的；
words.ex: The wise old man gave good advice.
words.ex_cn: 这位充满智慧的老人给出了很好的建议。
words.en: If you describe someone as wise, you mean that they have experience, knowledge, and good judgment.

words.tr:
n. 探测器；
v. 探查；
words.ex: The probe sent back photos from Mars.
words.ex_cn: 探测器从火星传回了照片。
words.en: If you probe into something, you ask questions or try to discover facts about it. A probe is also a long thin instrument that doctors and dentists use to examine parts of the body.

words.tr:
n. 碰撞；坠毁；崩溃；
v. 碰撞；坠毁；崩溃；
words.ex: The car crash happened at the intersection.
words.ex_cn: 汽车碰撞发生在十字路口。
words.en: If a vehicle crashes or if the driver crashes it, it hits something and is damaged or destroyed.

words.tr: n. 进入；入口；条目；参与；参赛作品；
words.ex: The entry to the building is locked after 10 PM.
words.ex_cn: 建筑物在晚上10点后进入通道会被锁上。
words.en: An entry is the act of going into a place or the right to go into it. It can also refer to a door, gate, or passage by which you enter a place. Additionally, an entry can be a piece of information recorded in a book, list, or computer, or the act of recording it.

words.tr:
adv. 相同地；相像地；
adj. 相同的；相像的；
words.ex: They dress alike.
words.ex_cn: 他们穿得一样。
words.en: If two or more things are alike, they are similar in some way.

words.tr: adj. 国内的；公民的；民用的；
words.ex: The country is recovering from a civil war.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在从一场内战中恢复。
words.en: relating to ordinary citizens and their concerns, as distinct from military or ecclesiastical matters.

words.ex: He wrote his name on a sheet of paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在一张纸上写了名字。
words.en: A sheet is a large piece of thin cloth used on a bed to lie on or under. It can also refer to a flat, thin piece of material, such as paper, metal, or glass.

words.ex: The police caught the man for a serious crime.
words.ex_cn: 警察抓住了那个犯下严重罪行的人。
words.en: A crime is an illegal action or activity for which a person can be punished by law.

words.ex: They tease him because he wears funny hats.
words.ex_cn: 他们因为他戴滑稽的帽子而戏弄他。
words.en: To tease someone means to make fun of them or try to provoke them in a playful way.

words.tr: n. 圣诞老人 (also Santa Claus)
words.ex: Santa brings gifts on Christmas Eve.
words.ex_cn: 圣诞老人在平安夜送礼物。
words.en: Santa Claus, or simply Santa, is a legendary figure originating in Western Christian culture who is said to bring gifts to the homes of well-behaved children on the night of Christmas Eve or during the early morning hours of Christmas Day.

words.ex: He wrote a draft of the letter before sending it.
words.ex_cn: 他在发送之前写了这封信的草稿。
words.en: A draft is a preliminary version of a piece of writing, or a current of air in a room or other confined space. It can also refer to the act of selecting someone for a particular purpose or task, especially in sports or the military.

words.ex: The shirt has small holes.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫上有小洞。
words.en: A hole is a hollow space in something solid, with an opening on one side.

words.ex: He tells jokes to make his friends laugh.
words.ex_cn: 他讲笑话让朋友们笑。
words.en: Jokes are things that someone says to cause amusement or laughter, especially a story with a funny punchline.

words.ex: The molten lava flowed down the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 熔化的岩浆从山上流下。
words.en: Molten is used to describe substances that have been heated to a very high temperature and have turned into a liquid.

words.ex: The statue is made of bronze.
words.ex_cn: 这座雕像由青铜制成。
words.en: Bronze is a yellowish-brown metal which is a mixture of copper and tin.

words.tr: v. 调整；使适合；使适应；
words.ex: He adjusted the chair to sit comfortably.
words.ex_cn: 他调整了椅子以便坐得舒服。
words.en: To adjust something means to change it so that it is more effective or appropriate, or so that it fits better.

words.tr: n. 远足；徒步旅行； v. 增加；“hike”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves hiking in the mountains on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末去山里远足。
words.en: Hiking is the activity of going for long walks in the countryside for pleasure.

words.tr: v. 拒绝；否认；“deny”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He denied my request for help.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝了我的求助请求。
words.en: If you deny something, you say that it is not true.

words.ex: He gave a verbal warning instead of a written one.
words.ex_cn: 他给了一个口头警告，而不是书面的。
words.en: Relating to or in the form of words.

words.tr:
adj. 主要的；重要的；
n. 主要产品；主要部分；主食；
words.ex: Rice is a staple food in many Asian countries.
words.ex_cn: 大米是许多亚洲国家的主要食物。
words.en: A staple is a basic food that is eaten regularly and in such quantities that it constitutes a dominant portion of a standard diet for a given people, supplying a large fraction of energy needs and generally forming a significant proportion of the intake of other nutrients as well.

words.ex: He went abroad to study medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他去国外学医。
words.en: In or to a foreign country or countries.

words.tr:
n. 过量；过度；超过；
adj. 多余的；
words.ex: The excess of sugar in his diet caused health problems.
words.ex_cn: 他饮食中糖分过量导致了健康问题。
words.en: An excess of something is a larger amount than is needed, allowed, or usual.

words.ex: My teacher is strict about homework deadlines.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师对作业截止日期要求很严格。
words.en: If someone is strict, they behave firmly and make sure that rules are obeyed.

words.ex: Leaves fall in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 树叶在秋季落下。
words.en: Autumn is the season between summer and winter when leaves change color and the weather becomes cooler.

words.tr: adj. 强健的；强壮的；结实的；
words.ex: The dog is robust and runs every day.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗很强健，每天跑步。
words.en: Strong and healthy; vigorous. (of an object) sturdy in construction.

words.tr:
adj. 内陆的；
adv. 向内地；在内陆；
n. 内地；内陆；
words.ex: The small village is located inland, far from the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这个小村庄位于内陆，远离大海。
words.en: Inland means situated in the interior of a country rather than on the coast.

words.ex: She tied the box with a thin string.
words.ex_cn: 她用一根细线把盒子绑了起来。
words.en: A string is a thin piece of rope or cord, or a series of things connected together.

words.ex: The snake has a deadly bite.
words.ex_cn: 这种蛇的咬伤是致命的。
words.en: If something is deadly, it is likely or able to cause someone's death, or has already caused someone's death.

words.tr: v. 强迫；推行； adj. 自己担负的 v. 强迫( impose的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The government imposed a new tax on sugar.
words.ex_cn: 政府强迫征收了一项新的糖税。
words.en: If you impose something on people, you use your authority to force them to accept it.

words.ex: The monkeys are climbing the trees.
words.ex_cn: 猴子们正在爬树。
words.en: Monkeys are mammals of the order Primates, which includes lemurs, lorises, tarsiers, and apes, including humans. They are known for their intelligence and social behavior.

words.tr: n. [微]菌株；[微]菌株（strain 复数）； v. 使过度劳累；
words.ex: These strains of bacteria can survive in extreme temperatures.
words.ex_cn: 这些菌株能在极端温度下生存。
words.en: If strain is put on an organization or system, it has to do more than it is able to do.

words.ex: We had an outdoor picnic last Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 上个星期天我们进行了户外野餐。
words.en: relating to or done in the open air; not inside a building

words.ex: The lion is the king of the animal kingdom.
words.ex_cn: 狮子是动物王国之王。
words.en: A kingdom is a country or region that is ruled by a king or queen.

words.ex: He lost his fortune in the stock market.
words.ex_cn: 他在股市中失去了他的财产。
words.en: A large amount of money or assets; chance or luck as an external force in human affairs.

words.ex: The density of water is 1 gram per cubic centimeter.
words.ex_cn: 水的密度是每立方厘米1克。
words.en: Density is a measure of how much mass is contained in a given unit volume of a substance.

words.ex: The company follows ethical practices in hiring.
words.ex_cn: 该公司在招聘中遵循伦理规范。
words.en: Relating to moral principles or the branch of knowledge dealing with these.

words.tr:
n. 最小值；
adj. 最小量的；
words.ex: The minimum of the function is 5.
words.ex_cn: 这个函数的最小值是5。
words.en: The minimum is the smallest or least amount possible or allowed.

words.ex: He is learning English grammar every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都在学习英语语法。
words.en: Grammar is the system and structure of a language. The rules of grammar help us decide the order we put words in and which form of a word to use.

words.ex: He goes to a music academy every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末去音乐学院。
words.en: An academy is a type of school for special training or a society for the advancement of art, science, or literature.

words.tr: v. 排水；“drain”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The boys drained the water from the pool.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们把池子里的水排干了。
words.en: If someone is drained, they are extremely tired and have no energy left.

words.ex: I suspect it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我猜想明天会下雨。
words.en: If you suspect someone of doing something wrong or dishonest, you believe that they have done it, although you have no proof.

words.tr:
n. 业余爱好者；
adj. 业余的；
words.ex: He is an amateur who paints on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他是个周末画画的业余爱好者。
words.en: An amateur is someone who does something as a hobby and not as a job.

words.ex: The mountain is immense.
words.ex_cn: 这座山非常巨大。
words.en: Extremely large or great, especially in scale or degree.

words.ex: He likes to study physics in school.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在学校学习物理。
words.en: Physics is the scientific study of matter, energy, force, and motion, and how they relate to each other.

words.tr: adj. 联邦的；联邦制的；联邦政府的；
words.ex: The federal government passed a new law.
words.ex_cn: 联邦政府通过了一项新法律。
words.en: A federal system of government is one in which there is a central government and separate governments for each of the states or regions.

words.ex: Her husband cooks dinner every night.
words.ex_cn: 她的丈夫每天晚上做晚饭。
words.en: A married man considered in relation to his spouse.

words.ex: The team's defence was very strong in the match.
words.ex_cn: 这支队伍在比赛中防守非常坚强。
words.en: The action of defending from or resisting attack.

words.tr: n. 话语；话语( remark的名词复数 )； v. 谈论；评论；
words.ex: His remarks made everyone laugh.
words.ex_cn: 他的话让大家笑了。
words.en: Comments or observations made about something or someone.

words.tr: n. 震动； v. 摇动；“shake”的现在分词；
words.ex: The shaking of the ground scared the children.
words.ex_cn: 地面的震动吓到了孩子们。
words.en: The act of moving something quickly back and forth or up and down.

words.tr: n. 习俗；习惯；关税；海关；“custom”的复数；
words.ex: In this village, it is a custom to light lanterns during the festival.
words.ex_cn: 在这个村庄，节日里点灯笼是一种习俗。
words.en: The place at a port, airport, or border where officials check the goods or luggage of people entering or leaving a country, and where they collect taxes on goods being imported.

words.ex: The epidemic spread quickly across the country.
words.ex_cn: 这种流行病迅速蔓延到全国。
words.en: An epidemic is a large number of cases of an infectious disease occurring at the same time.

words.tr: adj. 以…为导向的； v. “orient”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The program is student-oriented.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目是以学生为导向的。
words.en: If someone is oriented towards or oriented to a particular thing or person, they are mainly concerned with that thing or person.

words.ex: This necklace is precious to her.
words.ex_cn: 这条项链对她来说很珍贵。
words.en: If you say that something such as a resource is precious, you mean that it is valuable and should not be wasted or used badly.

words.tr: v. 纺（纱）；旋转；疾驰；“spin”的现在分词； n. 纺织；
words.ex: She is spinning wool into yarn.
words.ex_cn: 她正在把羊毛纺成纱线。
words.en: the process or activity of spinning fibers to produce yarn or thread.

words.tr: adj. 适应的；有适应能力的；
words.ex: The fish is adaptive to cold water.
words.ex_cn: 这种鱼能适应冷水。
words.en: If something is adaptive, it has the ability to change to suit different conditions.

words.tr: v. 耗尽；“deplete”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The batteries are depleted after long use.
words.ex_cn: 电池在长时间使用后耗尽了。
words.en: If you deplete something, you reduce the amount of it that is available.

words.tr:
n. 珍宝；宝物；财富；
v. 珍惜；
words.ex: The old map showed where the treasure was buried.
words.ex_cn: 那张旧地图显示了珍宝埋藏的地方。
words.en: If you treasure something that you have, you keep it or care for it carefully because it gives you great pleasure and you think it is very special.

words.ex: Glaciers are melting because of global warming.
words.ex_cn: 冰川因全球变暖而融化。
words.en: A glacier is a large, slow-moving mass of ice, formed from compacted layers of snow, that slowly deforms and flows in response to gravity.

words.ex: We go to the beach during holidays.
words.ex_cn: 我们在假期去海滩。
words.en: Holidays are days when people do not go to work or school, especially because of a religious or national celebration.

words.ex: I can't find my keys anywhere.
words.ex_cn: 我在任何地方都找不到我的钥匙。
words.en: in, at, or to any place, when it does not matter where

words.ex: He strictly follows the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他严格遵守规则。
words.en: In a manner that involves rigid enforcement or that demands complete conformity or exactness.

words.ex: The boy resembles his father.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩长得像他父亲。
words.en: If one thing or person resembles another, they are similar to each other.

words.tr: v. 互相作用；互相影响；交流；沟通；
words.ex: The two chemicals interact when mixed.
words.ex_cn: 这两种化学物质混合时会互相作用。
words.en: If people interact with each other, they communicate or work together.

words.ex: The universe is very big.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙非常大。
words.en: The universe is the whole of space and everything in it, including stars, planets, and galaxies.

words.ex: This festival is a regional tradition.
words.ex_cn: 这个节日是一个地区的传统。
words.en: Relating to or characteristic of a region.

words.tr: n. 水路；水道；航道；“waterway”的复数；
words.ex: The boats travel along the waterways to deliver goods.
words.ex_cn: 船只沿着水路运送货物。
words.en: Waterways are routes for travel or transport on water, such as rivers, canals, or channels.

words.tr: n. 在乡村住的人，村民( villager的名词复数 )
words.ex: The villagers walk to the market every morning.
words.ex_cn: 村民们每天早上步行去市场。
words.en: People who live in a village.

words.ex: He is an ambitious student who wants to become a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个有雄心的学生，想成为一名医生。
words.en: Having or showing a strong desire and determination to succeed.

words.ex: The residents of the village have lived there for generations.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄的长期居民已经在那里生活了几代人。
words.en: People who live in a particular place.

words.tr: v. 继承；遗传；“inherit”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 继承的；遗传的；遗留的；
words.ex: He inherited a small house from his grandfather.
words.ex_cn: 他从祖父那里继承了一所小房子。
words.en: Received from someone as a right or title by legal succession or descent.

words.tr:
adj. 精心制作的；详尽的；
v. 精心制作；详尽阐述；
words.ex: She wore an elaborate dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件精心制作的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: To elaborate means to add more details to something that has already been said or written, making it more complex or detailed. As an adjective, it describes something that is very complex and detailed.

words.ex: The tribe lives in a primitive hut.
words.ex_cn: 这个部落住在原始的小屋里。
words.en: Belonging to a very early period in the history of the world, or to a time before modern things existed.

words.tr: v. 发掘；挖出；开凿；挖掘( excavate的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: Workers excavated ancient pottery from the ground.
words.ex_cn: 工人们从地下发掘出了古代陶器。
words.en: To excavate means to dig in the ground, for example in order to build something or to find something.

words.ex: His intention was to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他的意图是帮助他的朋友。
words.en: An intention is an idea or plan of what you are going to do.

words.tr: n. 专门知识；专门技能；
words.ex: His expertise in computers helps the team solve problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在计算机方面的专门知识帮助团队解决问题。
words.en: Expertise is special skill or knowledge that is acquired by training, study, or practice.

words.tr: adj. 经验主义的；以经验为根据的；
words.ex: The scientist used empirical data to support her theory.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家使用经验数据来支持她的理论。
words.en: Empirical evidence or study relies on practical experience rather than theories.

words.tr: n. 劳动力；工人总数；职工总数；
words.ex: The factory needs a larger workforce to meet demand.
words.ex_cn: 工厂需要更多的劳动力来满足需求。
words.en: The workforce is the total number of people who are employed by a particular company or who are available to work in a particular country or area.

words.ex: The teacher has an assistant to help with grading.
words.ex_cn: 老师有一个助理帮忙批改作业。
words.en: An assistant is a person who helps in particular work or who is under the authority of another person.

words.ex: He was reluctant to leave his home.
words.ex_cn: 他不愿意离开家。
words.en: If you are reluctant to do something, you are unwilling to do it and hesitate before doing it, or do it slowly and without enthusiasm.

words.ex: He was diagnosed with flu last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周被诊断出患了流感。
words.en: If someone or something is diagnosed as having a particular illness or problem, their illness or problem is identified. If an illness or problem is diagnosed, it is identified.

words.ex: The islanders fish every morning.
words.ex_cn: 岛民每天早上捕鱼。
words.en: People who live on an island.

words.tr: v. 允许；允许( permit的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The teacher permitted us to leave early.
words.ex_cn: 老师允许我们早点离开。
words.en: Allowed or authorized, especially by an authority.

words.ex: Employers want workers who are honest and hardworking.
words.ex_cn: 雇主想要诚实且勤奋的员工。
words.en: Employers are individuals or organizations that hire and pay people to work for them.

words.tr: n. 伤残；失去能力；无能力；
words.ex: He has a disability that makes walking difficult.
words.ex_cn: 他有伤残，导致行走困难。
words.en: A disability is a physical or mental condition that limits a person's movements, senses, or activities.

words.ex: He likes to study philosophy in his free time.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在空闲时间学习哲学。
words.en: Philosophy is the study or creation of theories about basic things such as the nature of existence, knowledge, and thought, or about how people should live.

words.ex: He is optimistic about the future.
words.ex_cn: 他对未来持乐观态度。
words.en: Someone who is optimistic is hopeful about the future or the success of something in particular.

words.ex: Eating vegetables is beneficial to your health.
words.ex_cn: 吃蔬菜对你的健康有益。
words.en: Promoting or enhancing well-being; advantageous.

words.tr:
n. 亮点；
v. 使突出；
words.ex: The highlights of the concert were the final songs.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会的亮点是最后几首歌。
words.en: Highlights are the most interesting or memorable parts of something, such as an event or a period of time. It can also mean to emphasize or make something more noticeable.

words.ex: The occupation of the city by foreign troops lasted for years.
words.ex_cn: 外国军队对这座城市的占领持续了多年。
words.en: An occupation is a job or profession, or a way of spending your time.

words.ex: The earthquake shook the houses last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚地震震动了房屋。
words.en: An earthquake is a sudden shaking of the ground caused by the passage of seismic waves through Earth's rocks.

words.tr: adj. 地质学的；地质上的；
words.ex: The geological layers show the history of the Earth.
words.ex_cn: 这些地质层展示了地球的历史。
words.en: Relating to the study of the Earth's physical structure and substance, its history, and the processes that act on it.

words.tr: v. 面对；使面对；面对( confront的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He confronted his fear of public speaking.
words.ex_cn: 他面对了自己对公众演讲的恐惧。
words.en: Faced directly with something difficult or unpleasant, especially in order to deal with it.

words.ex: The storm caused a disruption in the train service.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴扰乱了火车服务。
words.en: Disruption is a situation in which something is prevented from continuing in its usual way because of problems or difficulties.

words.ex: I looked up the word in a dictionary.
words.ex_cn: 我在词典里查了这个词。
words.en: A dictionary is a book in which the words of a language are listed alphabetically, together with their meanings, pronunciations, and other information.

words.tr: adj. 不可避免的；必定的；
words.ex: It is inevitable that the sun will rise tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 太阳明天一定会升起。
words.en: If something is inevitable, it is certain to happen and cannot be prevented or avoided.

words.tr: n. 企业；事业；企划；“enterprise”的复数
words.ex: Small enterprises sell goods online.
words.ex_cn: 小企业在线销售商品。
words.en: An enterprise is a company or business, often a large one. It can also refer to a project or undertaking, especially one that is difficult or requires effort.

words.tr: adj. 专门的；特别的； v. “specialise”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He works in a specialised hospital for children.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家专门治疗儿童的医院工作。
words.en: Designed or developed for a particular purpose or area of knowledge.

words.ex: This painting has a distinctive style.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画有独特的风格。
words.en: Something that is distinctive has a special quality or feature which makes it easily recognizable and different from other things of the same type.

words.tr: n. 偏爱的事物；“preference”的复数；
words.ex: His preferences include coffee, books, and long walks.
words.ex_cn: 他的偏爱包括咖啡、书籍和长时间散步。
words.en: A preference is a greater liking for one alternative over another or others.

words.ex: The storm was destructive and broke many houses.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴具有破坏性，摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: Causing great and irreparable harm or damage.

words.ex: The competitors ran fast in the race.
words.ex_cn: 这些竞争对手在比赛中跑得很快。
words.en: A competitor is a person, team, or company that is competing against others.

words.ex: The city has many tall skyscrapers.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市有许多高大的摩天大楼。
words.en: A skyscraper is a very tall building of many stories.

words.ex: He is learning theoretical physics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习理论物理。
words.en: A theoretical study or explanation is based on or uses the ideas and abstract principles of a subject, rather than the practical aspects or uses of it.

words.ex: We had a short conversation about the weather.
words.ex_cn: 我们简短地聊了聊天气。
words.en: A conversation is a talk between two or more people, in which news and ideas are exchanged.

words.ex: He is studying anthropology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学里学习人类学。
words.en: Anthropology is the study of human societies and cultures and their development.

words.tr: v. 驯养；使爱家；适应家庭生活；“domesticate”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 喜欢家庭生活的；被驯养了的；
words.ex: Humans domesticated dogs thousands of years ago.
words.ex_cn: 人类在几千年前驯养了狗。
words.en: Domesticated animals or plants are those that have been tamed or cultivated by humans for companionship, food, or other uses, often altering their natural behaviors or characteristics to suit human needs.

words.ex: The teacher made an intervention to help the student.
words.ex_cn: 老师进行了干预以帮助学生。
words.en: Intervention is the act of intervening, especially in a situation to prevent something undesirable from happening.

words.tr: n. 采伐森林；森林开伐；
words.ex: Deforestation is killing many animals.
words.ex_cn: 采伐森林正在杀死许多动物。
words.en: The act of cutting down or burning all the trees in an area.

words.ex: The precipitation increased last week.
words.ex_cn: 上周降水增加了。
words.en: Precipitation is rain, snow, sleet, or hail — any kind of weather condition where something's falling from the sky.

words.ex: The paintings are artistic representations of nature.
words.ex_cn: 这些画作是对自然的艺术表现。
words.en: The act of speaking or acting on behalf of someone or the state of being so represented; the description or portrayal of someone or something in a particular way.

words.tr: adj. 奇怪的；奇数的；余的；
words.ex: He wore an odd hat to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一顶奇怪的帽子去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as odd, you mean that they are strange or unusual.

words.ex: He joins a chess club after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后加入了一个国际象棋俱乐部。
words.en: A club is an organization of people with a common purpose or interest, who meet regularly and take part in shared activities. It can also refer to a heavy stick used as a weapon or for hitting a ball in sports.

words.ex: The colors of the painting fade in the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画的颜色在阳光下逐渐消失。
words.en: To gradually grow faint and disappear.

words.ex: He decided to quit smoking last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年决定戒烟。
words.en: If you quit, or quit something, you stop doing it or leave it.

words.tr: v. 悬挂；“hang”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He hung the picture on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把画挂在墙上。
words.en: to suspend or be suspended from above with the lower part dangling free

words.tr: adj. 纯的；纯净的；纯粹的；
words.ex: She drank pure water from the spring.
words.ex_cn: 她喝了从泉水中取的纯净水。
words.en: Something that is pure is clean and does not contain any harmful substances.

words.ex: It is your duty to finish your homework.
words.ex_cn: 完成你的作业是你的职责。
words.en: A duty is a task or action that someone is required to perform.

words.ex: The potter shaped the clay into a bowl.
words.ex_cn: 陶匠把黏土塑造成一个碗。
words.en: Clay is a type of fine-grained natural soil material that contains hydrous aluminium phyllosilicates (clay minerals) that develops plasticity when wet.

words.tr:
n. 座位；
v. 使坐下；
words.ex: Please take your seat before the class starts.
words.ex_cn: 上课前请坐好你的座位。
words.en: A seat is an object that you can sit on, for example a chair.

words.tr: n. 毁灭；废墟；“ruin”的复数； v. 毁灭；破坏；
words.ex: The war left the city in ruins.
words.ex_cn: 战争使这座城市化为废墟。
words.en: The remains of a building, city, etc., that has been destroyed or is in a state of decay.

words.ex: The box has a cubic shape.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子是立方体形状的。
words.en: Relating to or involving the cube or cubes.

words.ex: The magnets have two poles.
words.ex_cn: 磁铁有两个极。
words.en: The term 'poles' refers to either of the two points at the ends of the axis of rotation of the Earth or another celestial body, or to a long, slender, rounded piece of wood or metal.

words.ex: The dog jumped over the fence.
words.ex_cn: 狗跳过了栅栏。
words.en: A fence is a barrier between two areas of land, made of wood or wire supported by posts. If you fence an area of land, you surround it with a fence.

words.tr:
adj. 警觉的；警惕的；
n. 警报；
v. （使）警惕；（使）戒备；
words.ex: The alert guard noticed the strange movement.
words.ex_cn: 这位警觉的警卫注意到了奇怪的动静。
words.en: If you are alert, you are paying full attention to things around you and are able to deal with anything that might happen.

words.ex: The angle of the roof helps rain run off.
words.ex_cn: 屋顶的角度有助于雨水流下。
words.en: An angle is the space between two lines or surfaces that meet, measured in degrees.

words.ex: The gross income of the company is $5 million.
words.ex_cn: 公司的总收入是500万美元。
words.en: If you describe something as gross, you mean it is very obvious, unacceptable, or unpleasant.

words.ex: The polar bear lives in the Arctic.
words.ex_cn: 北极熊生活在北极。
words.en: relating to the North or South Pole or to the region around it; having opposite extremes or characteristics.

words.ex: He uses logic to solve the puzzle.
words.ex_cn: 他用逻辑来解决这个谜题。
words.en: Logic is a method of reasoning that involves a series of statements, each of which must be true if the statement before it is true.

words.ex: She put the food on a clean plate.
words.ex_cn: 她把食物放在一个干净的盘子里。
words.en: A flat dish, typically circular and made of china, from which food is eaten or served.

words.ex: The ship carries a large cargo of rice.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船运载了大量大米货物。
words.en: Cargo refers to the goods carried by a ship, aircraft, or other large vehicle.

words.ex: Socio issues affect many families.
words.ex_cn: 社会问题影响许多家庭。
words.en: Relating to society or social matters.

words.ex: The soldier fought against his enemy in the war.
words.ex_cn: 士兵在战争中与他的敌人作战。
words.en: An enemy is someone who opposes you, competes with you, or is hostile towards you.

words.ex: He has fifty dollars in his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他口袋里有五十美元。
words.en: The number equivalent to the product of five and ten; ten more than forty; 50.

words.ex: There was an array of people at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会上人山人海。
words.en: An array of different things or people is a large number or wide range of them.

words.ex: The twins are playing in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 双胞胎正在花园里玩耍。
words.en: Twins are two offspring produced by the same pregnancy.

words.tr: adj. 不多的；适度的；谦虚的；
words.ex: He made a modest profit last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年的利润不多。
words.en: If you say that someone is modest, you approve of them because they do not talk much about their abilities or achievements.

words.ex: Plants release oxygen into the air.
words.ex_cn: 植物向空气中释放氧气。
words.en: A colourless, odourless reactive gas, the chemical element of atomic number 8 and the life-supporting component of the air.

words.ex: He works in a small studio near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他在公园附近的一个小工作室工作。
words.en: A studio is a room where an artist, photographer, or designer works, or a place where movies or television programs are made.

words.ex: Many tourists stay in hotels near the beach.
words.ex_cn: 许多游客住在靠近海滩的酒店里。
words.en: A hotel is a building where people stay, for example on holiday, paying for their rooms and meals.

words.tr: v. 倒；喷涌；（雨）倾盆而下；“pour”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He poured water into the glass.
words.ex_cn: 他把水倒进了玻璃杯里。
words.en: If you pour a liquid or other substance, you make it flow steadily out of a container by holding the container at an angle.

words.ex: The medicine is potent and works quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这种药物非常有效，起效很快。
