words.ex: He plays soft tunes on his guitar every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都在吉他上演奏轻柔的曲子。
words.en: A tune is a series of musical notes that are pleasant to listen to. When you tune a musical instrument, you adjust it so that it produces the correct notes.

words.ex: The painter used vivid colors to show the forest.
words.ex_cn: 画家用鲜艳的颜色来描绘森林。
words.en: If you describe memories and descriptions as vivid, you mean that they are very clear and detailed.

words.ex: He steers the team toward success.
words.ex_cn: 他引导团队走向成功。
words.en: To steer a vehicle, ship, or aircraft is to control its direction.

words.tr:
n. 刷子；灌木丛；
v. 刷；
words.ex: He cleaned the floor with a brush.
words.ex_cn: 他用刷子打扫了地板。
words.en: A brush is an object with a handle and a large number of bristles, hairs, or wires fixed to it, used for cleaning, painting, or arranging hair.

words.ex: The scope of this project includes three cities.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的范围包括三个城市。
words.en: The range of one's perceptions, thoughts, or actions.

words.ex: The cable connects the computer to the printer.
words.ex_cn: 这条电缆将电脑连接到打印机。
words.en: A cable is a thick wire or rope, or a bundle of wires or ropes, used to carry electricity or electronic signals, or to support a structure.

words.tr:
adj. 迅速的；敏捷的；快的；
n. 雨燕；
words.ex: The swift runner won the race.
words.ex_cn: 这位迅速的跑步者赢得了比赛。
words.en: moving or capable of moving at great speed, or happening within a very short time; fast.

words.tr:
n. 自豪；骄傲；
v. 对…感到自豪；
words.ex: He felt pride when his son graduated.
words.ex_cn: 当他儿子毕业时，他感到自豪。
words.en: A feeling of deep pleasure or satisfaction derived from one's own achievements, the achievements of those with whom one is closely associated, or from qualities or possessions that are widely admired.

words.ex: Family bonds keep us close together.
words.ex_cn: 家庭纽带让我们紧密相连。
words.en: Bonds are fixed-income securities that represent a loan made by an investor to a borrower (typically corporate or governmental).

words.ex: He carries three sacks of rice on his bike.
words.ex_cn: 他用自行车驮着三袋大米。
words.en: A sack is a large bag made of strong material such as burlap, used for storing and carrying goods. It can also refer to the act of dismissing someone from employment.

words.ex: The truck carried boxes to the store.
words.ex_cn: 卡车把箱子运到了商店。
words.en: A truck is a large vehicle that is used to transport goods by road.

words.tr: n. 商机；理想的工作或生活；
words.ex: He found a niche in selling eco-friendly phone cases.
words.ex_cn: 他在销售环保手机壳方面找到了商机。
words.en: A niche is a hollow area in a wall which has been made to hold a statue, or a comfortable or suitable position in life or employment.

words.ex: The boxing match took place in an arena.
words.ex_cn: 拳击比赛在竞技场举行。
words.en: An arena is a place or scene of activity, debate, or conflict, especially one where a competition or performance is held.

words.tr:
n. （鸟或羊）群；（人）群；
v. 聚集；群集；
words.ex: A flock of birds flew over the field.
words.ex_cn: 一群鸟飞过田野。
words.en: A flock is a group of birds, sheep, or goats, or a large group of people. It can also refer to a soft material for stuffing cushions, quilts, etc., made from wool or cotton. As a verb, it means to gather or move in a flock.

words.ex: He receives his wages every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五领工资。
words.en: Wages are the money that someone is paid each week by their employer, especially for work that is done manually or in a factory.

words.ex: The cortex of the brain controls thought and memory.
words.ex_cn: 大脑皮质控制思维和记忆。
words.en: The outer layer of an organ or body part, especially the outer layer of the brain.

words.ex: He plays tennis every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末打网球。
words.en: Tennis is a game played by two or four players on a rectangular court, in which a ball is hit back and forth over a net using rackets.

words.ex: He is deemed honest by everyone.
words.ex_cn: 大家都认为他诚实。
words.en: To consider or judge something in a particular way.

words.ex: He put the keys in his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他把钥匙放进了口袋里。
words.en: A pocket is a small bag sewn into or on clothing so that you can carry small objects such as money or keys in it.

words.ex: The tree has a hollow trunk.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树的树干是中空的。
words.en: If something is hollow, it has an empty space inside it.

words.ex: She looked at herself in the mirror.
words.ex_cn: 她对着镜子看自己。
words.en: A mirror is a flat piece of glass which reflects light, so that when you look at it you can see yourself reflected in it.

words.ex: He unfolded the map on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把地图在桌子上展开。
words.en: To open or spread out something that is folded; to develop or be revealed.

words.tr: n. 减缓；宽慰；解脱；救济；
words.ex: The medicine brought relief to his pain.
words.ex_cn: 这种药缓解了他的疼痛。
words.en: Relief is a feeling of reassurance and relaxation following release from anxiety or distress.

words.ex: The children were silent during the movie.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在看电影时很安静。
words.en: Someone or something that is silent makes no noise at all.

words.tr: v. 抓住；俘获；抓住( seize的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The cat seized the mouse.
words.ex_cn: 猫抓住了老鼠。
words.en: If a government or other authority seize someone's property, they take it from them, often by force.

words.tr:
n. 瘟疫；疫病；
v. 困扰；折磨；
words.ex: The plague killed many people in medieval Europe.
words.ex_cn: 瘟疫在中世纪的欧洲杀死了许多人。
words.en: A plague is a very infectious disease that spreads quickly and kills a lot of people. It can also refer to a large number of insects or animals that cause damage or are a nuisance.

words.tr: n. 网球拍；喧闹；非法勾当；
words.ex: He bought a new racket for tennis.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一副新的网球拍。
words.en: A racket is a piece of equipment used in sports such as tennis or badminton, consisting of a handle and a round or oval frame with a network of strings stretched across it. It can also refer to a loud, unpleasant noise or a dishonest or fraudulent scheme.

words.ex: Babies have an innate ability to cry.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿生来就有哭泣的能力。
words.en: An innate quality or ability is one that you were born with, not one you have learned.

words.ex: The water contains dangerous toxins.
words.ex_cn: 水中含有危险的毒素。
words.en: Toxins are poisonous substances produced within living cells or organisms.

words.ex: The countries formed a peace league.
words.ex_cn: 这些国家组成了一个和平联盟。
words.en: A league is a group of people, countries, or organizations that have joined together for a particular purpose, or because they share a common interest.

words.tr: n. 资产；财产；有价值的人或物；“asset”的复数；
words.ex: The company sold its assets to pay debts.
words.ex_cn: 公司出售了其资产来偿还债务。
words.en: Assets are items of value owned by a person or company, regarded as having value and available to meet debts, commitments, or legacies.

words.ex: The climbers reached the summit of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 登山者到达了山顶。
words.en: The highest point of a hill or mountain; a meeting between heads of government.

words.tr: v. 创造；制造硬币( coin的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He coined a new word for the invention.
words.ex_cn: 他为这项发明创造了一个新词。
words.en: To coin a word or phrase means to invent it.

words.tr: n. 鲑鱼；三文鱼；大马哈鱼；
words.ex: He grilled salmon for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他烤了鲑鱼当晚餐。
words.en: A salmon is a large silver-coloured fish which lives in the sea and rivers.

words.ex: The instructions are unclear.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明不清楚。
words.en: If something is unclear, it is not obvious or easy to see, understand, or be certain about.

words.ex: He needs surgery for his broken arm.
words.ex_cn: 他需要做手术来治疗断掉的胳膊。
words.en: Surgery is the medical specialty that uses operative manual and instrumental techniques on a patient to investigate or treat a pathological condition such as a disease or injury, to help improve bodily function or appearance, or to repair unwanted ruptured areas.

words.tr: adj. 脆弱的；易碎的；不牢固的；
words.ex: The glass is fragile and might break easily.
words.ex_cn: 这个玻璃很脆弱，容易碎。
words.en: If something is fragile, it is easily broken or damaged.

words.ex: The emperor ruled the country for many years.
words.ex_cn: 这位皇帝统治这个国家很多年。
words.en: A male sovereign ruler of an empire.

words.ex: Water causes erosion of the soil.
words.ex_cn: 水会导致土壤腐蚀。
words.en: The process by which the surface of the earth is worn away by the action of water, glaciers, winds, waves, etc.

words.ex: The weather can dictate what we wear each day.
words.ex_cn: 天气可以支配我们每天穿什么。
words.en: To dictate means to say or read something aloud for someone else to write down, or to give orders in an authoritative manner.

words.ex: The poem uses vivid imagery to describe the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗用生动的意象来描述日落。
words.en: Imagery consists of the elements in a poem or other literary work that appeal to the senses, especially sight.

words.ex: I caught a glimpse of the cat before it ran away.
words.ex_cn: 我在它跑掉之前瞥了一眼那只猫。
words.en: A glimpse is a brief, quick look at something or someone.

words.tr: v. 堆叠；堆积；“stack”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 堆满了…的；
words.ex: He stacked the books on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把书堆在桌子上。
words.en: Arranged in a stack or stacks.

words.ex: The drums play strong rhythms.
words.ex_cn: 鼓打出强烈的节奏。
words.en: Rhythms refer to a strong, regular, repeated pattern of movement or sound.

words.tr: adj. 最低限度的；极少的；最小的；
words.ex: He made minimal changes to the plan.
words.ex_cn: 他对计划做了最低限度的修改。
words.en: Something that is minimal is very small in quantity, value, or degree.

words.ex: The captain sailed the ship across the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 船长驾驶船穿越了海洋。
words.en: A captain is the person in charge of a ship or an aircraft, or a leader of a team or group.

words.ex: He asserts that the truth must be told.
words.ex_cn: 他坚持认为必须说出真相。
words.en: If someone asserts a fact or belief, they state it firmly.

words.ex: The gland secrete sweat to cool the body.
words.ex_cn: 腺体分泌汗液来降温。
words.en: If part of a plant, animal, or human secretes a liquid or substance, it produces it.

words.ex: The captive man sat quietly in his cell.
words.ex_cn: 那个被监禁的人安静地坐在牢房里。
words.en: A captive is someone who is being kept as a prisoner or in a confined space, or something that is held or confined.

words.ex: He tried to justify his mistake by saying he was tired.
words.ex_cn: 他试图以自己累了为由来证明自己的错误是正当的。
words.en: To justify something means to show or prove that it is reasonable, necessary, or correct.

words.ex: The lawyers are helping the client in court.
words.ex_cn: 律师们正在法庭上帮助客户。
words.en: A lawyer is a person who practices or studies law, especially (in the UK) a solicitor or a barrister or (in the US) an attorney.

words.ex: The medicine helps inhibit pain.
words.ex_cn: 这种药物有助于抑制疼痛。
words.en: If something inhibits an event or process, it prevents it or slows it down.

words.ex: The pond is shallow, so you can see the bottom.
words.ex_cn: 这个池塘很浅，所以你能看到底部。
words.en: If something is shallow, it does not extend far down from the top surface.

words.ex: We visited an art gallery on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们周日参观了一家艺术画廊。
words.en: A gallery is a place where works of art are shown to the public.

words.tr: n. 通过；通道；段落；短文；
words.ex: The passage of the train through the tunnel was quick.
words.ex_cn: 火车通过隧道的速度很快。
words.en: A passage is a long narrow space with walls or fences on both sides, which connects one place or room with another.

words.ex: The child is curious about the stars.
words.ex_cn: 孩子对星星感到好奇。
words.en: If you are curious about something, you are interested in it and want to know more about it.

words.ex: He found a way whereby he could save money.
words.ex_cn: 他找到了一种借以省钱的方法。
words.en: You use whereby to introduce a clause in which you mention the means by which something happens.

words.ex: Reptiles live on land and lay eggs.
words.ex_cn: 爬行动物生活在陆地上并产卵。
words.en: Reptiles are a class of cold-blooded vertebrates that are covered with scales and lay eggs on land.

words.tr: n. 新闻报道；覆盖范围；保险；
words.ex: The TV station gave full coverage to the earthquake.
words.ex_cn: 电视台对地震进行了全面的新闻报道。
words.en: The reporting or analysis of events by the media, or the extent to which something is covered.

words.ex: The settlers built houses near the river.
words.ex_cn: 殖民者在河边建造了房屋。
words.en: Settlers are people who go to live in a new country or area.

words.ex: He tried to persuade her to stay.
words.ex_cn: 他试图说服她留下。
words.en: If you persuade someone to do something, you cause them to do it by giving them good reasons for doing it.

words.tr: v. 发出；放出；发出，放出( emit的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The lamp is emitting a soft light.
words.ex_cn: 这盏灯正在发出柔和的光。
words.en: If something emits heat, light, gas, or a smell, it produces it and sends it out by means of a physical or chemical process.

words.ex: He tries to memorise the words every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天努力记住这些单词。
words.en: To memorise something means to learn it so well that you can remember it perfectly.

words.ex: He is bullying his little brother.
words.ex_cn: 他正在欺负他的弟弟。
words.en: The use of strength or influence to harm or intimidate those who are weaker.

words.tr:
adv. 向下地；
adj. 向下的；
words.ex: The leaves fell downward slowly.
words.ex_cn: 树叶慢慢向下飘落。
words.en: Moving or leading towards a lower place or level

words.ex: The universe may be infinite.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙可能是无限的。
words.en: If you describe something as infinite, you are emphasizing that it is extremely great in amount or degree.

words.ex: The dialogue in the movie was very funny.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影中的对白非常幽默。
words.en: A dialogue is a conversation between two or more people in a book, play, or film.

words.tr: adj. 严格的；缜密的；严密的；
words.ex: The teacher is rigorous about homework deadlines.
words.ex_cn: 老师对作业截止日期要求严格。
words.en: If you are rigorous in something, you are very thorough and strict in the way you do it.

words.ex: The disposal of waste is important for the environment.
words.ex_cn: 废物的处理对环境很重要。
words.en: The act or process of getting rid of something, especially by throwing it away or selling it.

words.tr: adj. 令人愉快的；合意的；宜人的；
words.ex: The weather was pleasant today.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气很令人愉快。
words.en: Something that is pleasant is enjoyable, attractive, or friendly.

words.tr: n. 拼写；拼法； v. “spell”的现在分词；
words.ex: His spelling is very poor.
words.ex_cn: 他的拼写很差。
words.en: The forming of words from letters according to accepted usage; orthography.

words.ex: The doctor made a diagnosis after checking the symptoms.
words.ex_cn: 医生在检查了症状后做出了诊断。
words.en: The identification of the nature of an illness or other problem by examination of the symptoms.

words.ex: The scientist studied tiny particles in the air.
words.ex_cn: 科学家研究了空气中的微小粒子。
words.en: Particles are extremely small pieces of matter, such as dust or molecules, that are part of a larger substance or that exist independently.

words.ex: The committee meets every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 委员会每周一开会。
words.en: A committee is a group of people who are chosen to do a particular job or make decisions on behalf of a larger group.

words.ex: Water can penetrate the soil slowly.
words.ex_cn: 水可以慢慢渗透进土壤。
words.en: To penetrate means to enter or pass through something, especially when this is difficult or when it is not obvious how to do it.

words.ex: Owls are nocturnal animals.
words.ex_cn: 猫头鹰是夜间活动的动物。
words.en: Nocturnal means happening in the night or active at night.

words.tr:
n. 西北；
adj. 西北的；
words.ex: The storm is moving from the northwest.
words.ex_cn: 风暴正从西北方向移动。
words.en: The northwest is the direction which is halfway between north and west.

words.tr: v. 取代；“displace”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The new robot displaced the worker on the assembly line.
words.ex_cn: 新机器人取代了装配线上的工人。
words.en: Forced to leave their home, especially because of war or a natural disaster.

words.tr: n. 间隔时间；[军事]间隔( interval的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The bus comes every 10 intervals.
words.ex_cn: 公交车每10分钟一班。
words.en: An interval is a period of time between two events or a space between two points.

words.ex: The outsiders were not allowed to join the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 外人不允许参加这次会议。
words.en: People who do not belong to a particular group or organization.

words.ex: His judgement was fair and smart.
words.ex_cn: 他的判断公正而明智。
words.en: The ability to make considered decisions or come to sensible conclusions.

words.tr: v. 征服；克服；攻克( conquer的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The army conquered the small kingdom last year.
words.ex_cn: 军队去年征服了那个小王国。
words.en: If you conquer something, you succeed in ending a problem or overcoming a difficulty.

words.tr:
n. 叙述；叙事；
adj. 叙述性的；
words.ex: He told a simple narrative about his childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他讲了一个关于他童年的简单故事。
words.en: A narrative is a story or an account of a series of events.

words.ex: The weather forecasts predict rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 天气预测说明天会下雨。
words.en: A forecast is a statement of what is expected to happen in the future, especially in relation to a particular event or situation.

words.tr: adj. 印象深刻的； v. 使印象深刻；“impress”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: I was impressed by her kindness.
words.ex_cn: 她的善良给我留下了深刻的印象。
words.en: If you are impressed by something or someone, you feel great admiration for them.

words.ex: The sun gives off radiation.
words.ex_cn: 太阳发出辐射。
words.en: Radiation is energy that comes from a source and travels through space at the speed of light. This energy has an electric field and a magnetic field associated with it, and has wave-like properties. You could also call radiation 'electromagnetic waves'.

words.tr: v. 装配；集合；“assemble”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The workers assembled the furniture last night.
words.ex_cn: 工人们昨晚装配了家具。
words.en: If people assemble or if someone assembles them, they come together in a group, usually for a particular purpose such as a meeting.

words.tr: v. 商议；商量；请教；翻阅；商议，商量( consult的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He consulted his friend before making a decision.
words.ex_cn: 他在做决定前咨询了朋友。
words.en: If you consult someone or something, you ask them for information or advice.

words.ex: They will negotiate the price with the seller.
words.ex_cn: 他们会与卖家协商价格。
words.en: If people negotiate with each other or negotiate an agreement, they talk about a problem or a situation such as a business arrangement in order to solve the problem or complete the arrangement.

words.ex: He has an addiction to video games.
words.ex_cn: 他对电子游戏上瘾了。
words.en: Addiction is the condition of being unable to stop using or doing something as a habit, especially something harmful.

words.ex: The company recruited five new employees last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司上个月招募了五名新员工。
words.en: If you recruit people for an organization, you select them and persuade them to join it or work for it.

words.tr: adj. 普遍的；流行的；盛行的；
words.ex: Smoking is prevalent in that country.
words.ex_cn: 在那个国家，吸烟很普遍。
words.en: If a condition, practice, or belief is prevalent, it is common or widespread.

words.tr:
adv. 在水下；
adj. 水下的；
words.ex: The divers swam underwater to explore the coral reef.
words.ex_cn: 潜水员在水下游泳以探索珊瑚礁。
words.en: Located, occurring, or used beneath the surface of the water.

words.ex: The teacher gave an evaluation of the student's work.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生的作业进行了评估。
words.en: An evaluation is a judgment about how good, useful, or successful something is.

words.ex: The line is horizontal on the graph.
words.ex_cn: 这条线在图上是水平的。
words.en: Parallel to the plane of the horizon; at right angles to the vertical.

words.ex: The opposition to the new law was strong.
words.ex_cn: 对这项新法律的反对很强烈。
words.en: Opposition is strong disagreement with or resistance to something, especially a plan, policy, or government.

words.tr:
n. 妥协；
v. 危及；
words.ex: They reached a compromise after hours of talk.
words.ex_cn: 经过数小时的讨论，他们达成了妥协。
words.en: A compromise is an agreement between two people or groups in which each side gives up some of the things they want so that both sides are happy at the end.

words.ex: He tried to manipulate the results to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 他试图操纵结果来赢得比赛。
words.en: To manipulate something means to handle or control it skillfully, often in a way that is considered unfair or dishonest.

words.ex: Good governance helps the city run smoothly.
words.ex_cn: 良好的治理有助于城市顺利运行。
words.en: The way that a country, company, etc. is controlled by the people who run it.

words.ex: His acceptance of the offer made everyone happy.
words.ex_cn: 他接受了这份提议，让大家都很高兴。
words.en: The act of agreeing to receive or undertake something offered.

words.tr: n. 药物；药物治疗；药物处理；
words.ex: He took his medication every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃药。
words.en: Medication refers to a substance used for medical treatment, especially a medicine or drug.

words.ex: The rain was continuous all day.
words.ex_cn: 雨一整天都在下个不停。
words.en: Something that is continuous happens or exists without stopping or being interrupted.

words.ex: The storm caused disastrous damage to the village.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴给村庄造成了灾难性的破坏。
words.en: If you describe something as disastrous, you mean that it is very unfortunate or unsuccessful.

words.tr: adj. 惊吓的；受惊的；害怕的； v. “frighten”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The child was frightened by the loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 孩子被巨大的噪音吓到了。
words.en: If you are frightened, you are anxious or afraid, often because of something that has just happened or that you think may happen.

words.tr: n. 领导才能；领导地位；
words.ex: His leadership helped the team win the match.
words.ex_cn: 他的领导才能帮助团队赢得了比赛。
words.en: Leadership is the ability to lead, guide, or direct a group, organization, or country.

words.ex: This small business is profitable.
words.ex_cn: 这家小企业有利可图的。
words.en: If something is profitable, it makes a profit or is beneficial.

words.ex: The cat made an instinctive jump to avoid the dog.
words.ex_cn: 猫本能地跳开以躲避狗。
words.en: An instinctive feeling, action, or idea is one that you have or do without thinking or reasoning.

words.ex: The drought destroyed many farmers' livelihoods.
words.ex_cn: 干旱摧毁了许多农民的生计。
words.en: A person's livelihood refers to the means by which they secure the necessities of life.

words.ex: The glass is transparent.
words.ex_cn: 这玻璃是透明的。
words.en: If something is transparent, you can see through it.

words.tr: n. 售货员；店员；“salesperson”的复数；
words.ex: The salespeople helped customers find the right products.
words.ex_cn: 售货员帮助顾客找到合适的产品。
words.en: Salespeople are individuals who are employed to sell products or services.

words.ex: The company is improving its recruitment process.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司正在改进它的招聘流程。
words.en: The process of finding and hiring new employees for a company or organization.

words.ex: There is uncertainty about the weather tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天的天气还不确定。
words.en: Uncertainty is a situation in which something is not known, or something that is not known or certain.

words.ex: The loud music was a distraction while I tried to study.
words.ex_cn: 当我试图学习时，大声的音乐让我分心。
words.en: Something that makes it difficult for you to concentrate on what you are doing.

words.ex: The doctor gave me antibiotics for my infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生给我开了抗生素来治疗感染。
words.en: Antibiotics are medicines that are used to treat infections caused by bacteria.

words.ex: His sensitivity to loud noises makes him wear earplugs.
words.ex_cn: 他对噪音的敏感性让他戴耳塞。
words.en: Sensitivity is the quality or condition of being sensitive—the capacity to respond to slight changes, signals, or influences.

words.ex: Scientists use radiocarbon to date ancient bones.
words.ex_cn: 科学家用放射性碳来测定古代骨骼的年代。
words.en: Radiocarbon is a radioactive isotope of carbon, especially carbon-14, used in archaeology for dating organic materials.

words.ex: They will reconstruct the old bridge next year.
words.ex_cn: 他们明年将重建这座旧桥。
words.en: If you reconstruct something that has been destroyed or badly damaged, you build it and make it work again.

words.ex: It is unnecessary to bring an umbrella today.
words.ex_cn: 今天带伞是不必要的。
words.en: If you describe something as unnecessary, you mean that it is not needed or does not have to be done, and often that it may be harmful or undesirable.

words.ex: The new legislation bans plastic bags.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法规禁止使用塑料袋。
words.en: Legislation refers to the process of making or enacting laws by a government or other authority.

words.ex: We made an arrangement to meet at 6 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 我们安排好晚上六点见面。
words.en: An arrangement is a plan or preparation which you make so that something can happen.

words.ex: The renaissance brought new art and ideas to Europe.
words.ex_cn: 文艺复兴为欧洲带来了新的艺术和思想。
words.en: The Renaissance was a period in European history marking the transition from the Middle Ages to modernity and covering the 15th and 16th centuries, characterized by an effort to revive and surpass ideas and achievements of classical antiquity.

words.ex: The disadvantage of living far away is long commute time.
words.ex_cn: 住得远的劣势是通勤时间长。
words.en: A disadvantage is a factor which makes someone or something less useful, acceptable, or successful than other people or things.

words.ex: Smoking is exacerbating his cough.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟使他的咳嗽更严重了。
words.en: Making a problem, disease, or negative situation worse or more severe.

words.ex: The disappearance of the keys confused everyone.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙的消失让所有人都感到困惑。
words.en: The act of disappearing or the state of having disappeared.

words.tr: n. 住处；膳宿；(交通工具内的)空间；
words.ex: The hotel provided cheap accommodation for travelers.
words.ex_cn: 酒店为旅客提供了便宜的住处。
words.en: Accommodation is a place where someone lives or stays, or the act of providing someone with a place to live or stay.

words.ex: The city is predominantly populated by young people.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市主要由年轻人居住。
words.en: If something is predominantly true, it is true to a much greater extent than it is false.

words.tr: n. （从事某一活动的）一套方法；（从事某一活动的）一套方法( methodology的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The team used new methodologies to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队使用了一套新方法来解决问题。
words.en: Methodologies refer to the systematic, theoretical analysis of the methods applied to a field of study. It comprises the theoretical analysis of the body of methods and principles associated with a branch of knowledge.

words.ex: This program supports developmental milestones in children.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目支持儿童的发展阶段。
words.en: Developmental is an adjective that describes something related to the growth or development of someone or something.

words.tr:
n. 代表；典型事物；
adj. 典型的；有代表性的；代议制的；
words.ex: He is the representative of our class.
words.ex_cn: 他是我们班的代表。
words.en: A representative is a person who has been chosen to act or make decisions on behalf of another person or a group of people.

words.ex: The organisational structure is clear and simple.
words.ex_cn: 组织结构清晰而简单。
words.en: Relating to the way in which the different parts of something are arranged or organized.

words.tr: n. 地区；地区，某地区的人，与某处邻近的地区( neighbourhood的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The neighbourhoods around the park are very quiet.
words.ex_cn: 公园周围的地区非常安静。
words.en: Plural of 'neighbourhood', meaning the district or area surrounding a person's home.

words.ex: The fox ran quickly through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 狐狸快速地跑过森林。
words.en: A fox is a wild animal which looks like a dog and has reddish-brown fur, a pointed face and ears, and a thick tail. Foxes are often described as cunning and sly.

words.ex: The jet flew high above the clouds.
words.ex_cn: 喷气式飞机在云层上方飞行。
words.en: A jet is an aircraft that is powered by jet engines, allowing it to fly at high speeds. It can also refer to a stream of liquid or gas forced out of a small opening, or to travel by jet aircraft.

words.ex: He begs for food on the street.
words.ex_cn: 他在街上乞讨食物。
words.en: If you beg someone to do something, you ask them very anxiously or eagerly to do it.

words.ex: The oak tree stands tall in the backyard.
words.ex_cn: 栎树矗立在后院。
words.en: An oak is a large tree that is common in northern countries. Oaks have strong wood and are often used for making furniture.

words.ex: He is sick and cannot go to school.
words.ex_cn: 他生病了，不能去上学。
words.en: If you are sick, you are ill. Sick can also mean feeling nauseous or wanting to vomit. Additionally, it can describe being very tired of something or someone because you have experienced too much of them.

words.ex: He ate soup from a bowl.
words.ex_cn: 他从碗里吃汤。
words.en: A bowl is a round container with a wide uncovered top. Some kinds of bowl are used, for example, for serving or eating food from, or in cooking, while other larger kinds are often used for washing or other purposes.

words.ex: The baby suck milk from the bottle.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿从奶瓶里吮吸牛奶。
words.en: To draw something into the mouth by creating a partial vacuum with the lips and tongue; to be very bad or unpleasant.

words.ex: They laid new tile in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 他们在厨房铺了新的瓷砖。
words.en: A tile is a flat piece of baked clay, carpet, cork, or other material, used especially for covering roofs and floors.

words.ex: The hind legs of the dog are stronger than the front ones.
words.ex_cn: 狗的后腿比前腿更强壮。
words.en: Located at or forming the back or rear of something.

words.ex: The worker wore a mask to avoid breathing in dust.
words.ex_cn: 这位工人戴上口罩以避免吸入粉尘。
words.en: Dust is a layer of fine, dry particles on the surface of something, or the fine, dry particles themselves.

words.tr:
v. 拖；拉；拖运；
n. 拖；拉；拖运；
words.ex: He hauled the heavy box across the room.
words.ex_cn: 他把沉重的箱子拖过了房间。
words.en: To haul something means to pull it or carry it with a lot of effort.

words.ex: She added a gram of salt to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 她往汤里加了一克盐。
words.en: A gram is a unit of weight in the metric system equal to one thousandth of a kilogram.

words.tr: n. 海角；突端; n. （Ness）人名；（德、英、西、瑞典）内斯，内丝（女名）
words.ex: The lighthouse stands at the ness of the rocky coast.
words.ex_cn: 灯塔矗立在岩石海岸的海角处。
words.en: A suffix used to form nouns indicating a state or quality.

words.ex: The index of 2 in 2^3 is 3.
words.ex_cn: 2^3 中 2 的指数是 3。
words.en: An index is a system by which changes in the value of something and the rate at which it changes can be recorded, measured, or interpreted.

words.ex: His answer was vague and hard to understand.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答不明确，难以理解。
words.en: If something written or spoken is vague, it does not explain or express things clearly.

words.ex: He ate a super big pizza.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一块超大的披萨。
words.en: If you describe something as super, you mean that it is very good indeed.

words.ex: He reads books as a hobby.
words.ex_cn: 他读书作为一种爱好。
words.en: A hobby is an activity that you enjoy doing in your spare time.

words.ex: He eats too much sugar and his liver is hurt.
words.ex_cn: 他吃太多糖，他的肝脏受损了。
words.en: The liver is a large organ in the body that cleans the blood and produces bile, or a person who lives in a particular way.

words.ex: The children are noisy in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在教室里很吵。
words.en: A noisy place is full of a lot of loud or unpleasant sounds.

words.ex: The lunar surface is covered with dust.
words.ex_cn: 月球表面覆盖着尘土。
words.en: Of or relating to the moon.

words.tr:
adj. 高尚的；
n. 贵族；
words.ex: He made a noble decision to help the poor.
words.ex_cn: 他做出了一个高尚的决定去帮助穷人。
words.en: If you say that someone is a noble person, you admire and respect them because they are unselfish and morally good.

words.ex: He believes he will go to heaven after death.
words.ex_cn: 他相信自己死后会去天堂。
words.en: In some religions, heaven is the place where God or the gods live and where good people go after they die.

words.ex: He excels in math.
words.ex_cn: 他擅长数学。
words.en: To be exceptionally good at or proficient in an activity or subject.

words.ex: She added cocoa to the cake batter.
words.ex_cn: 她把可可粉加到了蛋糕糊里。
words.en: Cocoa is a brown powder made from cocoa beans, used in making chocolate and in cooking.

words.ex: He did it out of spite.
words.ex_cn: 他出于恶意做了这件事。
words.en: If you do something out of spite, you do it because you want to hurt or upset someone.

words.tr:
v. 爆裂；突然而起；
n. 爆裂；突然而起；
words.ex: The balloon burst when he blew too much air.
words.ex_cn: 当他吹入太多空气时，气球爆裂了。
words.en: If something bursts or if you burst it, it suddenly breaks open or splits open and the air or other substance inside it comes out; used especially to describe the sound of something breaking open.

words.tr:
n. 坟墓；
adj. 严重的；
words.ex: They visited the grave of their grandfather.
words.ex_cn: 他们参观了祖父的坟墓。
words.en: A grave is a place where a dead person is buried. When used as an adjective, grave means serious or solemn.

words.ex: It's the other way versa.
words.ex_cn: 这是相反的。
words.en: The opposite side or counterpart of something.

words.ex: She blends flour and water to make dough.
words.ex_cn: 她把面粉和水混合在一起做面团。
words.en: To mix substances together so that they combine into a single substance.

words.ex: The bird picked up twigs to build its nest.
words.ex_cn: 鸟叼起小枝来筑巢。
words.en: Twigs are small, thin branches of a tree or bush.

words.tr:
n. 仙子；小精灵；
adj. 幻想中的；
words.ex: The little girl saw a fairy in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 小女孩在花园里看到了一位仙子。
words.en: A fairy is a mythical being of folklore and romance usually having magic powers and dwelling on earth in close relationship with humans.

words.tr:
n. 东西；原料；
v. 塞；填充；
words.ex: I need to clean up all this stuff.
words.ex_cn: 我需要清理这些东西。
words.en: If you stuff something somewhere, you push it there quickly and roughly. If you stuff a container or space with something, you fill it completely with that thing.

words.ex: He stayed awake all night to finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他整晚醒着完成作业。
words.en: If you are awake, you are not sleeping. If you awake, you wake up.

words.tr:
n. 流体；流质；
adj. 流动的；
words.ex: Water is a common fluid.
words.ex_cn: 水是一种常见的流体。
words.en: A fluid is a substance that can flow and change its shape easily, such as a liquid or a gas.

words.tr:
n. 外星人；外国人；外侨；
adj. 外国的；陌生的；相异的；
words.ex: The boy saw an alien in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在森林里看到了一个外星人。
words.en: An alien is someone who is not a citizen of the country in which they live, or a creature from outer space.

words.ex: He eats cheese every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃奶酪。
words.en: Cheese is a food made from the pressed curds of milk, often with added flavorings and sometimes with a hard or soft texture.

words.ex: He seldom eats fast food.
words.ex_cn: 他很少吃快餐。
words.en: If something seldom happens, it happens only occasionally.

words.tr: adv. 不管怎样；无论如何；
words.ex: I don't like the weather, but anyway, we will go for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢这天气，但不管怎样，我们会去散步。
words.en: You use anyway or anyhow to indicate that a statement explains or supports a previous point.

words.ex: The burial took place at sunrise.
words.ex_cn: 埋葬在日出时进行。
words.en: The act or ceremony of putting a dead body into a grave.

words.ex: She spread butter on her toast.
words.ex_cn: 她在吐司上抹了黄油。
words.en: Butter is a pale yellow edible fatty substance made by churning cream and used as a spread or in cooking.

words.ex: The fire produced small sparks.
words.ex_cn: 火焰产生了小小的闪光。
words.en: Sparks are small fiery particles thrown off from a fire, or a flash of light produced by an electrical discharge. It can also mean to ignite or cause something to start.

words.ex: The advent of smartphones changed how we communicate.
words.ex_cn: 智能手机的到来改变了我们的交流方式。
words.en: The arrival of a notable person, thing, or event.

words.ex: He lives in a small county in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 他住在乡村的一个小郡里。
words.en: A county is a region of a country used for administrative or other purposes in certain modern nations.

words.tr: adj. 可食用的；可以吃的；
words.ex: These mushrooms are edible and safe to eat.
words.ex_cn: 这些蘑菇是可食用的，安全可以吃。
words.en: Fit to be eaten as food.

words.tr: n. 君主的统治( reign的名词复数 ); 君主统治时期; 任期; 当政期
words.ex: The reigns of these kings lasted for many years.
words.ex_cn: 这些国王的统治持续了很多年。
words.en: Exercises control or authority, especially as a monarch or dominant force.

words.tr:
n. 失败；
v. 击败；战胜；
words.ex: The team accepted the defeat with pride.
words.ex_cn: 球队以自豪的态度接受了失败。
words.en: If you defeat someone, you win a victory over them in a battle, game, or contest.

words.ex: The old house had strong odours of damp wood.
words.ex_cn: 这所老房子有强烈的潮湿木头的气味。
words.en: Odours refer to smells, especially those that are strong or unpleasant.

words.ex: The bomb left a deep crater in the road.
words.ex_cn: 炸弹在道路上炸出了一个深深的弹坑。
words.en: A crater is a large hole in the ground, typically caused by an explosion or the impact of a meteorite.

words.ex: His legacy includes many charity schools.
words.ex_cn: 他的遗产包括许多慈善学校。
words.en: Something handed down from an ancestor or a predecessor or from the past.

words.ex: He ate a bunch of grapes for snack.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一串葡萄当零食。
words.en: Grapes are small, round, smooth-skinned fruits that grow in clusters on a grapevine. They can be eaten fresh or used to make wine, juice, or raisins.

words.ex: The medicine helped revive the sick man.
words.ex_cn: 这剂药帮助这位病人恢复了生机。
words.en: To revive something means to bring it back to life, consciousness, or use, or to make it active or successful again.

words.ex: The camera has two lenses.
words.ex_cn: 这台相机有两个透镜。
words.en: Lenses are pieces of glass or other transparent material that are used in optical instruments to form images by focusing light.

words.ex: The old estate has large gardens and a beautiful mansion.
words.ex_cn: 这个古老的庄园有大片花园和一座美丽的豪宅。
words.en: An estate is all the money and property that someone owns, especially everything that is left when they die.

words.ex: The slopes of the hill are steep.
words.ex_cn: 这座山的斜坡很陡。
words.en: A slope is a surface that is at an angle, so that one end is higher than the other.

words.tr:
n. 螺旋形；陡升或骤降；
v. 螺旋式上升（或下降）；
adj. 螺旋形的；
words.ex: The snail moved along a spiral path.
words.ex_cn: 蜗牛沿着一个螺旋形的路径爬行。
words.en: A spiral is a shape which winds round and round, with each curve above or outside the previous one.

words.ex: A sliver of wood stuck in his finger.
words.ex_cn: 一小片木头扎进了他的手指。
words.en: A sliver is a small, thin piece of something that has been cut, broken, or torn off from a larger piece.

words.ex: You must comply with the rules.
words.ex_cn: 你必须遵守规则。
words.en: To act in accordance with a wish or command.

words.tr:
v. 防止；战斗；抑制；
n. 战斗；
words.ex: The new law aims to combat pollution.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律旨在防止污染。
words.en: Combat refers to fighting, especially during a war. It can also mean to try to stop something harmful from happening or increasing.

words.ex: The actors performed a funny play last night.
words.ex_cn: 男演员们昨晚表演了一出滑稽的戏剧。
words.en: An actor is a person whose profession is acting on the stage, in films, or on television.

words.tr: n. 器官；机构( organ的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The heart is an important organ in the human body.
words.ex_cn: 心脏是人体中重要的器官。
words.en: Organs are parts of your body that have particular functions or jobs, such as the heart, lungs, or liver. They can also refer to organizations or parts of organizations that perform specific functions.

words.ex: A spider is crawling on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 一只蜘蛛正在墙上爬。
words.en: A spider is a small creature with eight legs and a body divided into two parts, which spins webs to catch insects for food.

words.ex: The boiler heats water for the house.
words.ex_cn: 锅炉为房子加热水。
words.en: A boiler is a device that heats water or produces steam.

words.ex: He will arrive shortly.
words.ex_cn: 他不久就会到。
words.en: In a short time; soon.

words.ex: The Tang dynasty was famous for its poetry and art.
words.ex_cn: 唐朝以诗歌和艺术而闻名。
words.en: A dynasty is a series of rulers of a country who all belong to the same family.

words.tr: n. 海港；海港( harbor的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The city has many harbors for fishing boats.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市有许多供渔船停靠的海港。
words.en: If you harbor someone who is being hunted by the police or other people, you hide them in your house or somewhere else.

words.ex: The removal of the old tree made the yard bigger.
words.ex_cn: 移除那棵老树让院子变大了。
words.en: The act of removing something or someone from a place or position.

words.tr:
n. 小心；警告；注意；
v. 警告；劝...小心；
words.ex: He drove with caution on the icy road.
words.ex_cn: 他在结冰的道路上小心驾驶。
words.en: Caution is care that you take in order to avoid possible danger or trouble.

words.tr: adj. 值得注意的；显著的；著名的；
words.ex: This is a notable achievement.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个值得注意的成就。
words.en: Worthy of attention or notice; remarkable.

words.ex: The workers drilled holes in the wall.
words.ex_cn: 工人们在墙上钻了孔。
words.en: To make a hole in something using a drill; to teach someone to do something by making them repeat it a lot of times.

words.ex: The thermal blanket keeps you warm.
words.ex_cn: 这个保暖毯让你暖和。
words.en: relating to heat or temperature

words.ex: This plant produces electricity using nuclear power.
words.ex_cn: 这座电厂使用核能发电。
words.en: relating to the nucleus of an atom, or to the energy produced when the nucleus of an atom is split or joined with another nucleus

words.ex: The book has a compact design.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的设计很紧凑。
words.en: A compact object or substance is small and dense, with all its parts closely packed together.

words.ex: He ate too much and his stomach hurt.
words.ex_cn: 他吃太多了，胃疼。
words.en: The stomach is the organ in your body where food is digested after you have eaten it.

words.ex: The hostile neighbor shouted at us every morning.
words.ex_cn: 那个敌意的邻居每天早上都对我们大喊大叫。
words.en: If you are hostile to another person or an idea, you disagree with them or disapprove of them, often showing this in your behavior.

words.ex: The revival of traditional music brought joy to many people.
words.ex_cn: 传统音乐的复兴给许多人带来了快乐。
words.en: The process of something becoming popular or active again after a period of inactivity or decline.

words.ex: He is hopeful about passing the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己通过考试抱有希望。
words.en: If you are hopeful, you are fairly confident that something that you want to happen will happen.

words.tr: adj. 焦虑的；渴望的；担忧的；
words.ex: He feels anxious before every test.
words.ex_cn: 他每次考试前都感到焦虑。
words.en: If you are anxious to do something or anxious that something should happen, you very much want to do it or very much want it to happen.

words.ex: Many families live in the suburbs to have more space.
words.ex_cn: 许多家庭住在郊区以获得更多的空间。
words.en: The suburbs are the residential areas on the outskirts of a city or large town.

words.tr: v. 回答；报复（reply 的过去式和过去分词）；
words.ex: He replied that he was tired.
words.ex_cn: 他回答说他累了。
words.en: To reply means to say or write something as an answer to a question or remark.

words.tr: adj. 再次发生的；再次兴起的；更新的； v. 更新；“renew”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The conflict was renewed after the peace talks failed.
words.ex_cn: 和平谈判失败后，冲突再次发生。
words.en: If something is renewed, it is made new again or replaced so that it is like new.

words.ex: She cooks dinner in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 她在厨房里做晚饭。
words.en: A kitchen is a room or part of a room used for cooking and food preparation in a dwelling or in a commercial establishment.

words.ex: The recipe calls for a mixture of flour and water.
words.ex_cn: 这个食谱需要一种面粉和水的混合物。
words.en: A mixture is a substance made by combining other substances together.

words.ex: A handful of students stayed after class to ask questions.
words.ex_cn: 少数学生课后留下来提问。
words.en: A handful of something is a small amount of it, especially when it is not enough or when it is difficult to manage.

words.ex: He felt boredom during the long meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在漫长的会议中感到无聊。
words.en: Boredom is the state of feeling bored.

words.ex: He was dipping the cookie into milk.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把饼干浸到牛奶里。
words.en: To dip means to put something quickly into a liquid and take it out again, or to go down to a lower level.

words.ex: The police caught the culprit who stole the bike.
words.ex_cn: 警察抓住了偷自行车的罪犯。
words.en: A culprit is someone who has done something wrong or illegal.

words.tr: v. 使大吃一惊；击晕( stun的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The news stunned her.
words.ex_cn: 这个消息让她大吃一惊。
words.en: If you are stunned by something, you are extremely shocked or surprised by it and therefore unable to speak or react for a while.

words.ex: The outward force pushed the door open.
words.ex_cn: 向外的力把门推开了。
words.en: An outward movement or position is one that is directed towards the outside or away from the centre.

words.tr: n. 卷轴；（常用于录写正式文件的）纸卷( scroll的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The ancient scrolls were found in a cave.
words.ex_cn: 这些古老的卷轴是在一个洞穴中发现的。
words.en: 1. A scroll is a long roll of paper or similar material with writing on it. 2. If you scroll through text on a computer screen, you move the text up or down to find the information that you need.

words.tr: n. 果园（orchard 的复数形式）
words.ex: The farmers work in the orchards every morning.
words.ex_cn: 农民们每天早上在果园里工作。
words.en: Areas of land where fruit trees are cultivated, especially for commercial production.

words.ex: The cats sleep on the rooftops.
words.ex_cn: 猫在屋顶上睡觉。
words.en: The upper covering of a building.

words.ex: The children's laughter filled the room.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们的笑声充满了房间。
words.en: The sound of people laughing, especially when it is loud and continuous.

words.ex: He felt great distress when he lost his job.
words.ex_cn: 当他失去工作时，他感到非常忧虑。
words.en: Distress is a feeling of extreme worry, sadness, or pain.

words.ex: His words had a profound effect on her life.
words.ex_cn: 他的话对她的生活产生了深远的影响。
words.en: If you describe something as profound, you mean that it is very great or intense.

words.ex: The village is at an altitude of 2,000 meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄的海拔是2000米。
words.en: The height of an object or point in relation to sea level or ground level.

words.tr: adj. 迷惑的；混乱的； v. 迷惑；混淆；“confuse”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He looked confused when the teacher asked the question.
words.ex_cn: 老师问问题时，他看起来很迷惑。
words.en: If you are confused, you do not know exactly what is happening or what to do.

words.ex: The campuses have big libraries and green parks.
words.ex_cn: 这些校园有大的图书馆和绿色的公园。
words.en: The grounds and buildings of a university or college.

words.tr: adj. 可怕的；极坏的；糟糕的；
words.ex: The storm caused a terrible flood.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴引发了一场可怕的洪水。
words.en: If something is terrible, it is very bad or of very poor quality.

words.ex: The peasants worked in the fields every day.
words.ex_cn: 农民们每天在田里劳作。
words.en: Peasants are poor people of low social status who work on the land, used especially in the past or in reference to less developed countries.

words.ex: The division of the cake was fair.
words.ex_cn: 蛋糕的划分是公平的。
words.en: The act or process of dividing something into parts or the state of being divided.

words.ex: The duration of the movie is two hours.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的持续时间是两小时。
words.en: The duration of an event or state is the time during which it happens or exists.

words.ex: Children have reliance on their parents for food and shelter.
words.ex_cn: 孩子依赖父母提供食物和住所。
words.en: Reliance is the state of depending on or trusting in someone or something.

words.ex: She sells textiles at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上卖纺织品。
words.en: Textiles are types of cloth or fabric, especially ones that have been woven.

words.ex: The movie shows too much violence.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影展示了太多的暴力。
words.en: Violence is behavior which is intended to hurt, injure, or kill people.

words.ex: The wind turbines spin slowly in the breeze.
words.ex_cn: 风力涡轮机在微风中缓慢旋转。
words.en: A turbine is a machine that produces power by using a wheel or rotor that is turned by a fast-moving flow of water, steam, gas, or air.

words.ex: He ate a moderate amount of food.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了适量的食物。
words.en: If you moderate something or if it moderates, it becomes less extreme or violent, or if you moderate a discussion, you help the people in it to reach an agreement.

words.ex: I can't tolerate loud noises.
words.ex_cn: 我无法容忍巨大的噪音。
words.en: If you tolerate a situation or person, you accept them although you do not particularly like them.

words.ex: It is uncommon to see snow in this city.
words.ex_cn: 在这个城市看到雪是不常见的。
words.en: If you describe something as uncommon, you mean that it does not happen often or is not often seen.

words.tr: v. 爆炸； adj. 爆破了的，被打破的 v. （使）爆炸( explode的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The old building exploded in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 那座旧大楼在早上爆炸了。
words.en: If an object explodes, it bursts violently as a result of pressure from inside, often making a loud noise and causing damage. If someone explodes, they express strong feelings suddenly and violently. If something explodes, it increases suddenly and rapidly in number or extent.

words.tr: n. 卡罗莱纳（美国州名）
words.ex: He moved to Carolina last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年搬到了卡罗莱纳。
words.en: Carolina refers to either of the two states in the southeastern United States: North Carolina and South Carolina.

words.tr: v. 排除，不包括在内；排除，不包括在内( exclude的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: Children under 12 are excluded from the game.
words.ex_cn: 12岁以下的儿童不被允许参加这个游戏。
words.en: If you exclude someone from a place or activity, you prevent them from entering it or taking part in it.

words.ex: I download music from the internet.
words.ex_cn: 我从互联网下载音乐。
words.en: To download data means to transfer it to your computer or device from another computer or from the internet.

words.tr: v. 挤出，榨出；挤压，捏；挤入，塞入；
words.ex: She squeezed the lemon to get the juice.
words.ex_cn: 她挤了柠檬以榨出汁液。
words.en: To press something firmly, especially from all sides in order to change its shape, reduce its size, or remove liquid from it.

words.ex: Scientists theorise that black holes exist.
words.ex_cn: 科学家们建立理论认为黑洞存在。
words.en: To theorise means to form a theory or set of theories about something.

words.ex: France is a republic with a president.
words.ex_cn: 法国是一个有总统的共和国。
words.en: A republic is a country where power is held by the people or their elected representatives, and which has an elected or nominated president rather than a monarch.

words.ex: We need to quantify the results of the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要量化实验的结果。
words.en: If you try to quantify something, you try to calculate how much of it there is.

words.ex: The park has many walking pathways.
words.ex_cn: 公园里有许多步行小径。
words.en: Pathways refer to routes or courses along which someone or something moves or along which something develops.

words.ex: The mariners sailed the ship across the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 这些海员驾船横渡了海洋。
words.en: Mariners are sailors or seamen who navigate and work on ships.

words.tr: adj. 有资格的；合格的； v. 取得资格；“qualify”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is a qualified teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有资格的老师。
words.en: Having the necessary qualifications for a particular job or task.

words.ex: The secretary types letters for the manager.
words.ex_cn: 秘书为经理打字。
words.en: A secretary is a person whose job is to do office work, such as typing letters, answering phone calls, and arranging meetings.

words.ex: The ghost is invisible to the human eye.
words.ex_cn: 这个鬼魂肉眼看不见。
words.en: If something is invisible, you cannot see it because it is hidden or because it is very difficult to see.

words.ex: The stability of the table prevents it from wobbling.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的固定防止它摇晃。
words.en: The state of being stable; the quality of being unchanging.

words.ex: He looked at her with suspicion.
words.ex_cn: 他带着怀疑的眼神看着她。
words.en: A feeling or thought that something is possible, likely, or true, especially something bad or wrong, without having proof.

words.tr: n. 好莱坞（美国电影业中心）
words.ex: He wants to work in Hollywood.
words.ex_cn: 他想在好莱坞工作。
words.en: Hollywood is an area in Los Angeles, California, known for its influence in the film industry, serving as the historical center of movie studios and stars.

words.ex: He inherited his ancestral land from his grandfather.
words.ex_cn: 他从祖父那里继承了祖传的土地。
words.en: Something that is ancestral relates to ancestors or to something that has been passed down from ancestors.

words.tr: adj. 有独创性的；巧妙的；
words.ex: The child came up with an ingenious way to solve the puzzle.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子想出了一个有独创性的方式来解决这个谜题。
words.en: Something that is ingenious is very clever and involves new ideas, methods, or equipment.

words.ex: The imbalance in income causes social problems.
words.ex_cn: 收入的失衡导致了社会问题。
words.en: An imbalance is a situation in which the elements or forces involved are not equal in strength or importance, leading to a lack of equilibrium.

words.tr: n. （学说、理论等的）基础；基础材料( underpin的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The theory underpins all modern physics.
words.ex_cn: 这个理论是所有现代物理学的基础。
words.en: If one thing underpins another, it helps the other thing to continue or succeed by supporting and strengthening it.

words.tr: adj. 无数的；多的；数不清的；
words.ex: There are countless stars in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 夜空中有无数颗星星。
words.en: Too numerous to count.

words.ex: The detection of smoke triggered the alarm.
words.ex_cn: 烟雾的探测触发了警报。
words.en: The act of detecting something, especially something that is not easy to see, hear, etc.

words.ex: He is a physicist who studies stars.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位研究恒星的物理学家。
words.en: A physicist is a scientist who specializes in the field of physics, which is the study of matter, energy, and the fundamental forces of nature.

words.ex: The book encompasses all basic math skills.
words.ex_cn: 这本书包含了所有基础数学技能。
words.en: If something encompasses particular things, it includes them.

words.ex: The old dwellings were small but cozy.
words.ex_cn: 这些旧住处虽然小，但很温馨。
words.en: Dwellings are houses or places where people live.

words.tr: adj. 抑郁的； v. 降低；“depress”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He felt depressed after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到抑郁。
words.en: If you are depressed, you are sad and feel that you cannot enjoy anything, because your situation is so difficult and unpleasant.

words.ex: He swallowed the pill with water.
words.ex_cn: 他用水把药片吞了下去。
words.en: To cause food, drink, or something else to pass from the mouth through the throat and into the stomach.

words.ex: The concert was wonderful.
words.ex_cn: 这场音乐会太精彩了。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as wonderful, you think they are extremely good.

words.ex: The new policy is for the promotion of clean energy.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策是为了促进清洁能源。
words.en: A promotion is a move to a more important job or rank in a company or organization.

words.ex: The fishermen go to sea early in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 渔民们一大早出海。
words.en: Fishermen are people who catch fish as a job or for sport.

words.tr: v. 挖掘；找到；“unearth”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The archaeologists unearthed an ancient pot.
words.ex_cn: 考古学家挖出了一件古代陶器。
words.en: If someone unearths facts or evidence, they discover them with difficulty, especially when they have been kept secret. If someone unearths something that is buried, they find it by digging in the ground.

words.ex: The lion lived in captivity for ten years.
words.ex_cn: 这只狮子被关押了十年。
words.en: The state of being imprisoned or confined.

words.ex: The amazonian bird sings loudly in the rainforest.
words.ex_cn: 这只亚马逊鸟在雨林中大声歌唱。
words.en: Relating to the Amazon River or the Amazon rainforest; resembling or characteristic of an Amazon, especially in being strong and aggressive.

words.ex: The team reached a consensus on the project plan.
words.ex_cn: 团队就项目计划达成了共识。
words.en: A consensus is general agreement among a group of people.

words.tr: n. 扩展；延长期；延伸；电话分机；
words.ex: The company added an extension to its office building.
words.ex_cn: 公司为办公楼加了一个扩建部分。
words.en: An extension is a part that is added to something to make it longer or larger, or the act of adding this part.

words.tr:
adj. 文盲的；无知的；
n. 文盲；无知识的人；
words.ex: He is illiterate and cannot read simple signs.
words.ex_cn: 他是文盲，无法阅读简单的标识。
words.en: Someone who is illiterate cannot read or write.

words.ex: Factories release pollutants into the river.
words.ex_cn: 工厂向河流排放污染物。
words.en: Pollutants are substances that make land, water, air, etc., dirty and not safe or suitable to use.

words.ex: This bird is a subspecies of the robin.
words.ex_cn: 这种鸟是知更鸟的一个亚种。
words.en: A subspecies is a taxonomic category that ranks below species, usually a fairly permanent geographically isolated race.

words.ex: The hikers got lost in the wilderness.
words.ex_cn: 徒步旅行者在荒野中迷路了。
words.en: A wilderness is a wild and uncultivated region, as of forest or desert, uninhabited or inhabited only by wild animals.

words.ex: This phone is affordable for students.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机对学生来说价格合理。
words.en: If something is affordable, most people have enough money to buy it.

words.tr: n. 行程安排； v. “schedule”的现在分词；
words.ex: The teacher made a scheduling for the week's lessons.
words.ex_cn: 老师制定了本周课程的行程安排。
words.en: The process of arranging, controlling, and optimizing work and workloads in a production process or manufacturing process.

words.tr: v. 构想出；构想出( formulate的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He formulated a simple plan to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他构想出一个简单的计划来解决问题。
words.en: Created or devised methodically. (formulated: past tense and past participle of formulate)

words.ex: Many immigrants work hard to build a new life.
words.ex_cn: 许多移民努力工作以建立新的生活。
words.en: Immigrants are people who come to live permanently in a foreign country.

words.tr: adj. 攻击性的；有进取心的；侵略性的；
words.ex: The dog showed aggressive behavior toward strangers.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗对陌生人表现出攻击性行为。
words.en: An aggressive person or animal has a quality of anger and determination that makes them ready to attack others.

words.tr: adj. 无关紧要的；不相关的；
words.ex: His opinion is irrelevant to the decision.
words.ex_cn: 他的意见与这个决定无关紧要。
words.en: If you describe something as irrelevant, you mean that it is not important to or not connected with the present situation or discussion.

words.ex: The project was a monumental task.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目是一项巨大的任务。
words.en: If you describe something as monumental, you are emphasizing that it is very large and impressive, or that it is of great importance or significance.

words.tr:
n. 代用品；代替物；
v. 替代；
words.ex: Honey is a good substitute for sugar.
words.ex_cn: 蜂蜜是糖的良好代用品。
words.en: A substitute is something or someone that takes the place or function of another.

words.ex: They are rebuilding the bridge after the storm.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在风暴后重建这座桥。
words.en: The act of building something again after it has been damaged or destroyed.

words.ex: The weather is favourable for a picnic.
words.ex_cn: 天气对野餐有利。
words.en: If your opinion or your reaction is favourable to something, you agree with it and approve of it.

words.tr: n. 沉思；反射；反映；反省；
words.ex: He sat quietly in the garden for reflection.
words.ex_cn: 他静静地坐在花园里沉思。
words.en: A reflection is an image that you can see in a mirror, glass, or water.

words.ex: There is a high likelihood of rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天很大可能会下雨。
words.en: The likelihood of something happening is how likely it is to happen.

words.ex: It is worthwhile to learn a new language.
words.ex_cn: 学习一门新语言是值得的。
words.en: If something is worthwhile, it is enjoyable or useful enough to make the effort or money spent on it seem reasonable.

words.tr: n. 遗传学家；遗传学工作者；
words.ex: The geneticist studied how traits are passed from parents to children.
words.ex_cn: 这位遗传学家研究了性状是如何从父母传给孩子的。
words.en: A geneticist is a biologist who studies genetics, the science of genes, heredity, and variation of organisms.

words.tr: n. 支持者；拥护者；“supporter”的复数；
words.ex: The supporters cheered loudly for their team.
words.ex_cn: 支持者们为他们的球队大声欢呼。
words.en: People who support a particular person, group, or idea.

words.ex: The government wants to improve healthcare for everyone.
words.ex_cn: 政府希望为所有人改善医疗保健。
words.en: Healthcare refers to the organized provision of medical care to individuals or a community.

words.ex: Scientists use telescopes to see stars.
words.ex_cn: 科学家用望远镜看星星。
words.en: A telescope is an instrument shaped like a tube with lenses inside it, used for making distant objects look larger and nearer.

words.ex: Reading a book gives me relaxation.
words.ex_cn: 读书让我放松。
words.en: Relaxation is the state or process of becoming less tense, anxious, or stressed.

words.ex: The house has good insulation to keep warm in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有良好的绝缘层以在冬天保暖。
words.en: Insulation is a material or substance that is used to stop heat, electricity, or sound from going from one place to another.

words.ex: He asked for permission to leave early.
words.ex_cn: 他请求允许早点离开。
words.en: If someone who has authority over you gives you permission to do something, they say that they will allow you to do it.

words.ex: The company showed compliance with safety rules.
words.ex_cn: 该公司遵守了安全规定。
words.en: The act of complying with a wish, request, or demand; obedience.

words.ex: The factory uses automation to make cars.
words.ex_cn: 工厂使用自动化来制造汽车。
words.en: The use of largely automatic equipment in a system of manufacturing or other production process.

words.ex: The farm suffered from an infestation of insects.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场遭受了昆虫的侵袭。
words.en: An infestation is a large number of pests or parasites that have invaded a place and are causing harm.

words.tr: v. 容纳；适应；为...提供住宿；
words.ex: The hotel can accommodate 200 guests.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店能容纳200位客人。
words.en: If a building or space can accommodate someone or something, it has enough room for them.

words.ex: His involvement in the project helped it succeed.
words.ex_cn: 他参与这个项目帮助它取得了成功。
words.en: The act of taking part in something or the state of being connected with something.

words.ex: The bright lights caused stimulation in her eyes.
words.ex_cn: 明亮的灯光引起了她眼睛的刺激。
words.en: The act of arousing or accelerating physiological or psychological activity or response in an organism or any of its parts.

words.tr: adj. 人口统计的；人口的；
words.ex: The survey collected demographic data like age and income.
words.ex_cn: 这项调查收集了年龄和收入等人口统计数据。
words.en: Relating to the structure of populations.

words.ex: The well draws water from groundwater.
words.ex_cn: 这口井从地下水取水。
words.en: Water that is located beneath the earth's surface in soil pore spaces and in the fractures of rock formations.

words.ex: Adolescents often like to listen to music.
words.ex_cn: 青少年通常喜欢听音乐。
words.en: Young people in the early stages of adulthood, typically between ages 13 and 19.

words.tr: n. 顾问工作；顾问职位；咨询公司；
words.ex: He works in consultancy for big companies.
words.ex_cn: 他为大公司做顾问工作。
words.en: Consultancy is the business or activity of giving expert advice to people working in a particular field.

words.ex: The advancement of technology helps people live better.
words.ex_cn: 技术的进步帮助人们生活得更好。
words.en: The process of promoting a cause or plan; the act of moving forward or making progress.

words.ex: He continually checks his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他不停地查看手机。
words.en: If something happens continually, it happens without stopping or happening repeatedly over a period of time.

words.ex: The restoration of the old house took two years.
words.ex_cn: 这座老房子的修复花了两年时间。
words.en: The act of returning something to its original condition, or the state of being returned to its original condition.

words.ex: The prisoners suffered from sleep deprivation.
words.ex_cn: 囚犯们因睡眠剥夺而受苦。
words.en: Deprivation is the lack or denial of something considered to be a necessity.

words.ex: The country gained independence in 1960.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家在1960年获得了独立。
words.en: Independence is the freedom from control or influence of others, allowing one to make decisions and act on one's own.

words.ex: The bank recorded all transactions yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 银行昨天记录了所有交易。
words.en: Transactions are the actions or processes of buying, selling, or exchanging goods, services, or money.

words.tr: n. 社会学家（sociologist 的复数形式）
words.ex: Sociologists study how people live in groups.
words.ex_cn: 社会学家研究人们如何在群体中生活。
words.en: Experts in the study of human society and social behaviour.

words.tr: v. 弄清；确定；查明；弄清，确定，查明( ascertain的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is ascertaining the truth by asking questions.
words.ex_cn: 他通过提问来弄清真相。
words.en: If you ascertain the truth about something, you find out what it is, especially by making a deliberate effort to do so.

words.ex: The radio signal suffered from interference.
words.ex_cn: 收音机信号受到了干扰。
words.en: Interference refers to the action of interfering or the process of being interfered with, especially in a context where it is unwelcome or inappropriate.

words.tr: n. [ similarity ]的复数形式; 类似( similarity的名词复数 ); 相像性
words.ex: There are similarities between apples and oranges.
words.ex_cn: 苹果和橙子有相似之处。
words.en: The state or fact of being similar; resemblance.

words.ex: He accidentally dropped his phone on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心把手机掉在地上了。
words.en: If something happens accidentally, it happens by chance or without being planned.

words.ex: The exploitation of natural resources helps the economy grow.
words.ex_cn: 自然资源的开发有助于经济发展。
words.en: The action or fact of treating someone unfairly in order to benefit from their work, or the utilization of something for profit or gain.

words.ex: Good coordination between teams improves work efficiency.
words.ex_cn: 团队之间的良好协调能提高工作效率。
words.en: The organization of the different elements of a complex body or activity so as to enable them to work together effectively.

words.ex: Caterpillars eat leaves in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 毛毛虫在花园里吃叶子。
words.en: The larval stage of a butterfly or moth, having a segmented wormlike body with three pairs of true legs and several pairs of appendages similar to legs.

words.tr: n. 与某处邻近的地区；临近街坊；地区( neighborhood的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The neighborhoods near the park are very quiet.
words.ex_cn: 公园附近的地区非常安静。
words.en: A neighborhood is a district, especially one forming a community within a town or city.

words.ex: He received a certification for completing the course.
words.ex_cn: 他完成了课程后获得了证明。
words.en: Certification is the act of certifying or the state of being certified, often involving the issuance of a certificate or official document attesting to a status or level of achievement.

words.ex: Graduating with honors was her greatest accomplishment.
words.ex_cn: 以优异成绩毕业是她最大的成就。
words.en: Something that has been achieved successfully.

words.ex: Microorganisms live in the soil.
words.ex_cn: 微生物生活在土壤中。
words.en: Microscopic living organisms, such as bacteria, viruses, and fungi, often invisible to the naked eye.

words.ex: The reintroduction of wolves helped balance the forest ecosystem.
words.ex_cn: 狼的再引入帮助平衡了森林生态系统。
words.en: The act of introducing something again, especially a species of animal or plant into an area where it has become extinct or rare.

words.ex: The neuroscientist studies how the brain works.
words.ex_cn: 这位神经科学家研究大脑是如何工作的。
words.en: A neuroscientist is a scientist who specializes in the study of the nervous system, including the brain, spinal cord, and networks of sensory nerve cells called neurons.

words.ex: The scientist did experimentation to find the answer.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家做了实验来寻找答案。
words.en: The process of performing scientific experiments in order to test a hypothesis or demonstrate a known fact.

words.ex: The instructions were straightforward and easy to follow.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明很简单，容易遵循。
words.en: If you describe something as straightforward, you approve of it because it is easy to do or understand.

words.ex: The country's industrialisation began in the 1950s.
words.ex_cn: 该国的工业化始于20世纪50年代。
words.en: Industrialisation is the process by which an economy is transformed from primarily agricultural to one based on the manufacturing of goods. Individual manual labor is often replaced by mechanized mass production, and craftsmen are replaced by assembly lines.

words.ex: She stored jam in a glass jar.
words.ex_cn: 她把果酱存放在一个玻璃罐里。
words.en: A jar is a glass or clay container with a wide opening at the top and a lid, used especially for storing food.

words.ex: He wants to rid his house of clutter.
words.ex_cn: 他想摆脱家里的杂乱。
words.en: To rid someone or something of something unwanted or harmful means to remove it completely from them.

words.ex: The bird lives in a small cage.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟住在一个小笼子里。
words.en: A cage is a structure of wire or metal bars in which birds or animals are kept.

words.tr:
n. 鞭策；
v. 刺激；
words.ex: The competition served as a spur to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 竞争成了推动他更努力工作的鞭策。
words.en: A spur is something that makes you want to do something or that encourages you to do it. It can also refer to a sharp device worn on the heel of a rider's boot to urge a horse forward.

words.ex: The bulb broke when it fell on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 灯泡掉到地上时碎了。
words.en: A bulb is the glass part of an electric lamp, which gives out light when electricity passes through it. It can also refer to a rounded underground storage organ present in some plants, notably those of the lily family, consisting of a short stem surrounded by fleshy scale leaves or leaf bases, lying dormant over winter.

words.ex: The bees made a loud buzz near the flowers.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂在花附近发出嗡嗡声。
words.en: To make a low, continuous, humming or sibilant sound, like that made by bees or flies.

words.tr:
n. 眼泪；泪水；
v. 撕裂；撕开；
words.ex: A tear fell down her cheek when she heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 当她听到这个消息时，一滴眼泪从脸颊滑落。
words.en: A tear is a drop of clear salty liquid that is produced by the glands in your eyes when you cry or when your eyes are irritated.

words.ex: The ancient tomb was filled with artifacts.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的坟墓里充满了文物。
words.en: A tomb is a place where a dead person is buried, especially a large, impressive structure.

words.ex: He ate popcorn made from corn.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了用玉米做的爆米花。
words.en: Corn is a tall plant which produces long vegetables covered with yellow seeds. It is also a cereal crop.

words.ex: He stood amid the trees, quiet and still.
words.ex_cn: 他站在树木中间，安静而静止。
words.en: If something is amid other things, it is surrounded by them.

words.ex: The cubs are playing in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 小熊在森林里玩耍。
words.en: Cubs are young animals, especially young lions, bears, wolves, etc. It also refers to a member of the junior section of the Scout Association, for boys aged about 8 to 11.

words.ex: The bottle has a cork stopper.
words.ex_cn: 这个瓶子有一个软木塞。
words.en: Cork is a light, porous material obtained from the bark of the cork oak tree, used especially for making stoppers for bottles.

words.tr: v. 铺路；铺设；“pave”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The road was paved last summer.
words.ex_cn: 这条路去年夏天被铺好了。
words.en: Covered with a firm surface, especially of flat stones or bricks.

words.ex: His anger grew when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到这个消息时，他的愤怒增加了。
words.en: A strong feeling of annoyance, displeasure, or hostility.

words.ex: The boy hurt his spine when he fell from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 他从树上摔下来时伤到了脊柱。
words.en: The spine is the row of bones down the center of your back that supports your body and protects your spinal cord.

words.ex: He sat on the chair and read a book.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在椅子上读书。
words.en: A chair is a piece of furniture for one person to sit on, with a back and usually four legs.

words.ex: Smoking damages your lungs.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟会损害你的肺。
words.en: The lungs are the organs in the chest that allow you to breathe.

words.ex: The deer walked through the scrub near the hill.
words.ex_cn: 鹿穿过了山边的灌木丛。
words.en: To scrub something means to rub it hard in order to clean it, especially using a stiff brush and water.

words.tr: n. 阵营（指观点相同且与持不同观点者对立的集团）；兵营；营地( camp的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The two camps argued loudly about the new law.
words.ex_cn: 两个阵营就新法律激烈争论。
words.en: A camp is a place where people live temporarily in tents or other temporary structures.

words.ex: The ozone layer protects us from the sun's harmful rays.
words.ex_cn: 臭氧层保护我们免受太阳有害射线的伤害。
words.en: Ozone is a form of oxygen that has three atoms in each molecule, and it is a pale blue gas with a pungent smell. It is found in the Earth's atmosphere and absorbs ultraviolet radiation, which is harmful to living organisms.

words.tr: adj. 未固定牢的；宽松的；
words.ex: The loose screw fell off the table.
words.ex_cn: 那个松动的螺丝从桌子上掉了下来。
words.en: Not firmly or tightly fixed in place; detached or able to be detached.

words.ex: He bought a loaf of bread from the bakery.
words.ex_cn: 他从面包店买了一条面包。
words.en: Bread is a food made from flour, water, and usually yeast, mixed together and baked.

words.ex: He urged his friend to cheat on the test.
words.ex_cn: 他怂恿朋友在考试中作弊。
words.en: If you urge someone to do something, you try hard to persuade them to do it.

words.ex: I shall go to the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天要去公园。
words.en: used to indicate future action or intention, or to express obligation or necessity

words.tr:
n. 流动；
v. 漂移；
words.ex: The drift of the river carries leaves downstream.
words.ex_cn: 河流的流动将树叶冲向下游。
words.en: If something or someone drifts somewhere, they move there slowly or gradually. As a noun, drift can refer to a slow, gradual movement or change, or the general meaning or intent of something.

words.ex: The lid is tight on the jar.
words.ex_cn: 罐子的盖子很紧。
words.en: Something that is tight is fastened or fixed firmly and is not loose.

words.ex: He rubbed his belly after eating too much.
words.ex_cn: 他吃完太多后揉了揉腹部。
words.en: The belly is the front part of a person's or animal's body between the chest and the legs.

words.ex: The herds graze peacefully in the open field.
words.ex_cn: 牧群在开阔的田野里安静地吃草。
words.en: A herd is a large group of animals of one kind that live together. It can also refer to the act of gathering and moving animals in a group.

words.ex: The onset of winter brought heavy snow.
words.ex_cn: 冬天的开始带来了大雪。
words.en: The onset of something is the beginning of it, especially something unpleasant.

words.ex: The goats eat grass on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 山羊在山上吃草。
words.en: Goats are animals that are related to sheep. They are often kept for their milk, meat, or wool.

words.ex: The sun shines brightly in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在早晨明亮地发光。
words.en: To emit or reflect light brightly; to be very good at something.

words.tr:
n. 烤肉；烘烤；
adj. 烤的；焙的；
v. 烤；烘烤；
words.ex: We had roast for dinner last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚我们吃了烤肉。
words.en: To cook food, such as meat, in an oven or over a fire.

words.ex: The water is toxic to fish.
words.ex_cn: 这种水对鱼是有毒的。
words.en: If a substance is toxic, it is poisonous.

words.ex: He felt hunger after running for an hour.
words.ex_cn: 他跑了一个小时后感到饥饿。
words.en: A strong desire or need for food.

words.ex: The city's sprawl has covered many farmlands.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的杂乱无序的拓展覆盖了许多农田。
words.en: If you sprawl somewhere, you sit or lie with your legs and arms spread out in a careless way.

words.ex: She put the apples in a basket.
words.ex_cn: 她把苹果放进了一个篮子里。
words.en: A basket is a container which is usually made of stiff fibers, such as rushes, straw, or thin strips of wood, and is used for carrying or storing things.

words.tr: n. （某物）相当大的数量或部分；厚厚的一块；厚厚的一块( chunk的名词复数 )；
words.ex: He ate chunks of bread with cheese.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了大块的面包配奶酪。
words.en: A chunk of something is a large amount or large part of it.

words.ex: Running a business entails hard work.
words.ex_cn: 经营企业必然需要努力工作。
words.en: If one thing entails another, it involves it or causes it.

words.ex: He explores different realms of science.
words.ex_cn: 他探索科学的不同领域。
words.en: A realm is an area of activity, interest, or knowledge, or a country ruled by a king or queen.

words.ex: The canary sings beautifully in the cage.
words.ex_cn: 金丝雀在笼子里唱得非常动听。
words.en: A canary is a small yellow bird which is known for its singing.

words.ex: The aromas of fresh bread filled the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 新鲜面包的香气充满了厨房。
words.en: Aromas are pleasant, distinctive smells, often associated with food, flowers, or other natural sources.

words.tr: adj. 命中注定的； v. 注定；“doom”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The doomed ship sank in the storm.
words.ex_cn: 那艘命中注定的船在风暴中沉没了。
words.en: If something is doomed, it is certain to fail or be destroyed.

words.ex: The king lives in a big palace.
words.ex_cn: 国王住在一座巨大的宫殿里。
words.en: A palace is a very large impressive house, especially one which is the official home of a king, queen, or president.

words.ex: He was sent to prison for stealing.
words.ex_cn: 他因偷窃被送进了监狱。
words.en: A prison is a building where criminals are kept as punishment or where people accused of a crime are kept before their trial.

words.tr:
adj. 巨大的；强大的；
adv. 非常；
words.ex: The mighty river flows through the valley.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的河流流经山谷。
words.en: Possessing great power, strength, or force; formidable.

words.tr:
v. 惊异于；惊异；
n. 令人惊异的人（或事）；
words.ex: I marvel at how fast she runs.
words.ex_cn: 我惊异于她跑得有多快。
words.en: If you marvel at something, you express your great surprise, wonder, or admiration.

words.ex: The government announced a major reform in education.
words.ex_cn: 政府宣布了教育方面的重大改革。
words.en: If someone reforms a system, they change or improve it.

words.ex: He spilled powder on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他把粉末撒在了地上。
words.en: A powder is a dry substance made up of very small particles. It can be used for various purposes, including cosmetics, cleaning, and cooking. As a verb, to powder means to apply or cover something with powder.

words.ex: The fish swim above the seabed.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在海床上方游动。
words.en: The seabed is the bottom of the ocean, consisting of various sediments and rocks.

words.ex: The rocket flew into space.
words.ex_cn: 火箭飞入了太空。
words.en: A rocket is a spacecraft, aircraft, or other vehicle that obtains thrust from a rocket engine.

words.ex: The boy picked up a piece of rubber from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 男孩从地上捡起一块橡胶。
words.en: Rubber is a strong, waterproof, elastic substance made from the juice of some tropical plants or artificially. It is used for making tires, boots, and many other products.

words.tr:
n. 格式；
v. 格式化；
words.ex: The file is in PDF format.
words.ex_cn: 这个文件是PDF格式。
words.en: The way in which something is arranged or set out.

words.ex: The kettle produces vapour when the water boils.
words.ex_cn: 水烧开时，水壶会产生水汽。
words.en: Vapour is a substance in the gas phase at a temperature lower than its critical temperature, which means that the vapour can be condensed to a liquid by increasing its pressure without reducing the temperature.

words.ex: He earned the esteem of his colleagues through hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他通过努力工作赢得了同事们的尊重。
words.en: If you esteem someone or something, you respect or admire them.

words.tr:
adj. 每年的；
adv. 每年地；
words.ex: He pays his rent yearly.
words.ex_cn: 他每年支付一次房租。
words.en: Happening or done once a year or every year.

words.ex: The doctor adjusted the dosage of the medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生调整了药物的剂量。
words.en: The amount of a medicine or drug that is taken at one time or over a period of time.

words.ex: The barren land cannot grow any crops.
words.ex_cn: 这片贫瘠的土地无法种植任何庄稼。
words.en: If you describe something as barren, you mean that it is not able to produce anything, especially plants or crops.

words.ex: The guest arrived at the party early.
words.ex_cn: 客人早早到了派对。
words.en: A guest is someone who is visiting a place or attending an event by invitation, without having a permanent role there.

words.ex: The horror of the dark made her scream.
words.ex_cn: 对黑暗的恐惧让她尖叫。
words.en: A feeling of great fear, shock, or disgust.

words.ex: The animals found refuge in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这些动物在森林中找到了避难所。
words.en: A place or state of safety or shelter from danger, trouble, or difficulty.

words.ex: The slaves worked in the fields every day.
words.ex_cn: 这些奴隶每天在田地里劳作。
words.en: A slave is a person who is the legal property of another and is forced to obey them.

words.ex: The legend says a dragon lives in the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 传说有一条龙住在山里。
words.en: A legend is a very old and popular story that may be true or may be imaginary.

words.ex: The mantle lies below the Earth's crust.
words.ex_cn: 地幔位于地球地壳之下。
words.en: The mantle is the part of the earth between the crust and the core. It can also refer to a cloak or covering.

words.tr: adj. 随意的；非正式的；偶然的；
words.ex: He wore casual clothes to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了随意的衣服去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe someone's attitude or behavior as casual, you mean they are not very concerned about what they are doing or what is happening around them, or they are not taking it seriously.

words.ex: The poison is lethal to humans.
words.ex_cn: 这种毒药对人类是致命的。
words.en: Something that is lethal can kill people or animals.

words.ex: The water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.
words.ex_cn: 水在100摄氏度时沸腾。
words.en: Celsius is a scale for measuring temperature, in which water freezes at 0 degrees and boils at 100 degrees.

words.ex: Malaria is endemic in some parts of Africa.
words.ex_cn: 疟疾在非洲某些地区是地方性的。
